text: Despite that it is quite fun, and there are some clever elements within the game making it enjoyable, for the sheer amount of constant pop-ups pushing transactions upon you this is not for me after just 10 levels. Finished with the dice? Pop-ups. Finished with the building? Pop-ups. Done with something else? Pop-ups. And 5 each time you have to close. That's 5 popups in a row pushing for a transaction, as if you didn't know that a minute earlier after closing the previous 5.

This is just an irritating game on all fronts. It lures you in, giving you great progress in the first few days of playing, but then suddenly stops and your progress halts unless you're willing to spend money. You can barely even play the game thanks to the incessant pop-ups trying to get you to spend. The RNG mechanics are set up to make you fail. Save yourself the stress and download another game because this one is naff 👎🏻

It starts out as a fun game but quickly becomes irritating with 4 pop-ups asking for money after using up the available dice rolls. Then another pop-up asks you to invite friends. Even entering the game presents you with pop-ups begging for money. I've noticed this has been an issue for some time, with reviews mentioning this from 2024, so it's unlikely to change. It's too frustrating to be something worth playing long-term...

Still loving this game after playing it for 2 years or so. Everything about it is fun it is one of my favourite games and I have played alot, vibrant, colourful and achievable the one downside if you are trying to buy your pet and you are on the last 2 levels the points you have need to achieve it is often unatainable before time runs out which is very disappointing and really very annoying especially when you buy bundles to try and achieve the end goal, its ridiculous!!!

I love the game, however the more packs you buy the more expensive it becomes to play which is not good if you are looking to keep players. The mini game "Join" well that is a waste of time as it automatically forces you play it, there should be an option to decline it. The new feature on the tournament is awful, I do not need to hear silly notifications everytime I move up or down in the tournament, I've now had to switch off sound effects which is rubbish!

would of been 5* till you get two weeks into game level 53 and now no video ads available for me, so no progress without spending on game, feedback bot states " Please keep in mind that free ads may appear from time to time and their availability can vary between players based on different in-game factors. Because the game experience is personalized, free ads may not always be available during every play session"

It’s incredibly frustrating playing competitive events in Dice Dreams when the leaderboards are clearly rigged. The point scaling makes it impossible to compete fairly without emptying my wallet, and you always end up grouped with players racking up magically impossible scores at the last second. It ruins the fun. The reply from the game developers I got for this was complete BS. They only address finding "more fun ways to give coins" yet didn't address anything else.

It's fun and a bit too addictive 🤣🤣 I've upped from 4 star to 5 star because I can keep playing without paying, I just watch the adverts. Only one issue is that you can't unfriend people. EDIT: Since the latest update, it is very slow in loading, each icon is slow to show up. Also, on the free dice rolls, it completely freezes. It doesn't resolve by exiting, only after a few times.

I'm loosing a lot as most of the time when I get the feature, Fight, when the game chooses an opponent for me and going to find out what prize we'll be fighting for, my game gets frozen and there is nothing else to do just to log off and log back into the game, but I'm spending a lot of my money and I have complained about it number of times but the issue hasn't been sorted out and it's been for a while. answer to your question, which feature, it's, Fight feature

easy to use. great game for killing time and for those that like to collect and move rapidly through levels. eye-catching and quit addictive. As you move up through the levels it really does push you to buy in-game purchases. i reached a point where it seemed impossible to move on without a purchase.

I thought I would test this to see if you can make some money, and reach the target levels without spending any cash. After playing for some time I succeeded in getting to a high level and made two of their larger payouts! Of course these companies don't like that! Suddenly shock horror they said that there was an anomaly, accused me of cheating, removed the amount made and stopped me withdrawing. it's a scam! wait for AI response below asking to contact them, I have, they refuse to answer.

could be 5 star, had there not be so many things pop up after running out of dice, or completing other tasks. Would be nice to see some smaller notifications on the home screen, that do not interrupt you. Otherwise, a great little game, like many others but has a very fun and addictive feel to it.

Progress is 100% linked to how much you spend, a fact they flood you with constantly everything is on a time limit thats overly short to get you to spend money, it bombards you with "deals" to spend money on that just give you more rolls to basicly repeat the same thing over and over again. Its a horrible cash grab attempt for a game that has no progress other than your board number going up, same thing every time and everything is always just out of reach unless you make purchases.

glitching, it just keeps opening chests and won't let me do anything at all. I have a screen recording of it. it's been happening for over a week. I've signed out and then back in, deleted data and cache and uninstalled then reinstalled. I can't even message support via the app. I love this game and I'm gutted it isn't working

I like the game. however it does throw me out often and every time I log back in the 5 ads and offers reappear....having to close them. as they each of them has there own icon I don't see why they need to keep popping up. it lags out and throws me out. maybe pop up once a day and when time is running out

I was very much enjoying this game. They actually paid out when you reached the required levels and you were able to earn free rolls of the dice by watching videos. I therefore was going to give 5 stars but, it would seem that as soon as your earnings enter double figures the option of earning rolls watching ads is removed so you either have to wait an hour to get 8 free rolls or make purchases. Very disappointing. Which is why I've now reduced the rating to only 3 stars.

It's a fun game apart from the 16 bloody side missions and the sales pitches. There is a stupidly annoying amount of buy this, buy that, do this challenge, collect these things. Could we have less of them please? If you want a quick fun game for lunchtime, this might not be the one for you. It can take 5 minutes to get through everything before the actual playing screen.

incredibly annoying game. im building, let me build and stop forcing me to roll dice when I have enough to build every building. constantly explaining the extremely obvious steps. your spending more time having to click back to when you was trying to do than anything else. wouldnt recommend. when you put your age, make the game go in line with that age. or at least give option to turn off the over the top click outs. Just completely breaks any illusion of enjoyment.

I love this game! I love it so much. the problem is it never misses a chance to shove an offer for me to pay them money in my face. If I was interested, I would have taken the offer the first time. now, every time I run out of rolls or enter the game, I gotta close 5 offers. every. single. time. would be 5 stars but I hate pushy advertising. enough that it only gets 2.

uninstalling this game it's boring and the same old same old. you can't trade gold stickers so you don't even complete the whole sets. not completed a set for nearly 2 weeks. make all dishes not made one for 2 weeks. trail you're lucky to get to level 5 on it. even doing the ads to get the free loot isn't enough. gardening buddies I've never even completed a full one with just 1 partner let alone 4 partners. thought this game was going to be different but nope it's all about getting you to bit'

I really like this game, its enjoyable and really addictive, but my friends plays the same game and he has the option to watch ads for additional rewards, for example; if he doesn't have enough gold to finish the construction of a building, it prompts him with an ad to finish it early. I would love to have this feature. is there any reason I dont get ad rewards?

it's cute but there's no skill involved. it feels like you are simply tapping the screen when prompted rather than making any decisions for your self. the music is annoying but the game is very playable except for the inevitable demands for 3.99 for opening piggy. other players are those who's town you visit your own being vunerable too.

I really enjoy this game, so much so that I started buying some of the packs but the more I brought the more expensive they kept getting, I won't be spending anymore on the game now because it's getting greedy unless they review thier prices and keep it sensible then they won't be getting another penny from me, I will still play because it's a fun little pass time though.

There's not much to say about this other that its just dice with pop ups for the apps microtransactions & telling you to piss off your friends on Facebook with invites like most free2play mobile apps do. There is the raid, attack & rock paper scissors mini games & their fine. I can't progress any further now because I'm stuck on the pachinko machine, because doesn't respond to my inputs even after reinstalling.

I told my husband about this game after I had been playing for several days. I'm now on level 47 and he has passed 100. Why? He has a smart phone and I have an Android, that seems to be the answer.He gets free spins on the trails all the time and progresses quicker. I don't get free spins on the trail. Also the game turns my phone off mid session or just closes. I just got 450 free spins on the map, my phone switched off and when I reloaded, the spins had gone. Good game but frustrating me.

There's soo many pop ups it freezes the game to the point when I load it up I just have to leave my phone for 5+ mins to catch up because the screens empty (I have a good phone and really good internet fyi). Also, we don't need 4 pop ups telling us to buy stuff when we run out of rolls? it's sucked the fun out of an okay game. I actively avoid going below 2 rolls.

So many extra mini games going on the actual game doesn't even load properly and crashes/freezes over and over. In the earlier levels (1-3)when I could actually play it was great fun but what's the point in trying when it can't even keep up with the extra useless BS that is just annoying and boring. Have also made multiple purchases that I pay for and never receive due to the game barely holding its self together. Seriously unimpressed and only made it to level 7 - I think..

Entertaining but sometimes doesn't pay out rewards.. Specifically the tournament. I have finished in the top 10 twice and not been rewarded. The first time I contacted customer service and received the reward the next day, the second time I had no response. This is leading to shortcomings on other rewards

Unlike their other game that I trashed; Domino Dreams, where that game almost purposely fights you by giving you the worst luck to make you spend and lose, this game is much more generous. This game actually rewards you properly by playing with a fair sense of achievement with kingdom progression with generous rewards. The pop ups that intrude at the start every time you open the game is annoying, but that's the cost of a free game. I recommend either way.

Super cute and really fun game. Addicting but quickly losing interest Rewards are too small and too far between. It takes thousands upon thousands of rolls to rank in tournaments. Trails are tough to complete without buying steps or rolls. Completing tasks and challenges, such as growing a pet by feeding it, is next to impossible without spending a lot of money. Many people have voiced this on the FB page but developers aren't listening. Also, pricing for packages is not equal for all players

This the game is a lot more fun than I thought rolling a couple of dice could ever be. The graphics are really fun to watch the animations of the characters that are just silly & funny. The game is actually pretty exciting because you get to steal $$$ from other people, attack another player's building for $$$, and you never really know what your three dice are going to land on. I've played a couple of other games from this company and I really liked what they make.

I spend $20-$30 a week on in game purchases. I contacted them when a $3.99 purchase was charged but never credited to my game. I sent screen shots showing it was not applied & showing it was still locked but they curtly told me it was credited??? I had proof but they would not correct it. They lost a player who spends more than $100 a month over $3.99, great customer service. Plus all my friends are deleting the game too because they see that you can't trust them. Smart business move guys.

This game is more annoying than fun to play. As soon as you load into the game you are bombarded with pop ups and tabs to purchase things. You run out of dice for rolls you are once again bombarded with pop ups. You can earn event items, but can only progress a few stages in events then are forced to buy stages to progress. For a "free to play game" there's a lot of pay walls to actually progress.

Game is entertaining enough, but the pay to play aspect is really in your face. Sometimes you will have to close out 5-6 pop up ads in a row. Side quests that look like you collect in-game items to complete usually require some sort of purchase to get past the second level, no matter how many items you collect. Gameplay is very limited for those of us not willing to spend a lot of money.

I am still waiting for customer service to get back to me about an issue with receiving tournament rewards and their customer service always takes 3 days to get back to you after events end which cause you to loose out on more rewards. Edit: I did reach out to support through email, the app, and Facebook. It's been over 8 hours, and still nothing, what a waste of money and such a disappointment.

Bombarded with give me money, give me money, give me money every time you load the app or run out of rolls. They also added 'rewards' that take up spots on the quest tracks that can only be used after spending money. None of the other slot games do that and it's super frustrating that you can't use your 'rewards' without spending money. The trail has also added extra obstacles (to waste your rolls) to continue making it much harder to progress.

The game is simple but fun enough. Plenty of cute graphics and animations. Major downside is the excessive amount of in-game pop-ups and you should be prepared to close 10+ windows every time the game is opened before you can play anything. After you run out of dice there is an additional 3 or so pop-ups to close every time. It's also the kind of game that pesters you to invite your friends.

This is a game? I'm taken aback by just how little there is to actually DO in this app. Everything just involves you tapping the screen & occasionally choosing which structure you want to "attack". If you're the kind of gamer that can get hours if entertainment from a slot machine that doesn't pay out actual cash, then I guess you'll have fun here? Two stars for the presentation, but this isn't worth the time needed to earn in TesterUp.

Cute game but insane amount of pop ups. I enjoyed the game itself but I had to sift through 25 pop ups this morning before I could even play. Ad after ad trying to get me to make an in game purchase. It's obnoxious and it's why I uninstalled the game. I shouldn't need to spend 5 minutes sifting through that many pop ups before I can even play. Plus you get bombarded with the same pop ups anytime you run out of coins or rolls. It's excessive.

I love playing this, it's a great way to pass the time. You can also get free dice by watching ads so you don't have to pay unless you really want to. That being said I think past a certain level the game stops letting you watch ads for dice. I'm roughly at level 165, and I've stopped receiving those prompts. That or my game is bugged.

The game started out being entertaining, but it has way too much going on. I counted 21 pop-up screens I had to close before I could roll my first turn when I opened the game. The other drawback is that it often leaves you no choice but to attack friends on your social media list. I don't want to set my friends back in their game play! You had a decent idea for a game, but all the extras suck the fun out of it.

There are ten pop-ups for in game purchases every time you open the app, and every time you run out of dice. Absolutely obnoxious. Most events are pay-to-win. Cost of doing things like building stuff gets way too high compared to the resources you get from playing. unless you get lucky with card packs or something, you don't get that many dice. At low dice, you can't do anything to advance, and at high dice (in thousands) the game gets boring, and also you run out of dice in maybe 15 mins.

Installed this through mistplay to earn points for Google play cards and it's the easiest money I've ever made. This is one of those games that you begin playing and completely fall into, makes an hour feel like 10 mins. Only complaint is, it can be difficult without spending, but def not impossible, just much slower going. I have huge issues with anxiety/panic disorders and this helps distract my brain, which is huge in my little world. All this said, would recommend.

We need teams back... the moral of the game is down I feel. We used to be abke to complete team tasks, why did this end. If purchasing Dice, you would sell more if you charged less. for 5 bucks you should get at least 10,000 dice, not 20 dollars... Bringing trams back and making side games and achievements a little less hard to win or get to... and there has been a lot of glitches where people lose out on things and never get reimbursed. I do like that you brought back the watch video for rolls!

I love this game. It's actually the 2nd time I've installed and played it. It is kind of addictive, but very fast paced and fun. And to this day it remains the Only game I've Ever spent any money to play, not much, but I'm cheap and want to be paid to play, not the other way around lol but you find you just want to keep playing! Soyeah, Dice Dreams is awesome! 💯👍

too many glitches and developers changing options on the fly. i always use the 25x multiplier, but it keeps randomly disappearing. options go from 10to 50. support seems to be mostly AI canned responses or try to explain how to select the multiplier. been playing for years, i know how to play. I've confirmed this is happening to others. stop modifying the options and changing them back randomly!

if i could give zero, I would. Screenshot or record your gameplay because if the game glitches, and it will, the game support will argue with you and tell you you are wrong, even with picture proof. They will also just end the help ticket when they want, even if the problem is not resolved. "Helper peon" Claire is the worst of them all. there you go i sent a video of the conversation and what happened. --- waste of time--- rating stays the same. they are full of canned responses.

I really enjoy playing this game with good graphics and storyline. I don't like every time you play the game you have to wait for like 10 different packages to pay for. it would be nice to just start the game and play instead of waiting all those that you have to exit out. I look for games that I can do the same as others w/o having to pay a fortune. I hav nt had income over 2yrs and it's nice to be able to enjoy a game but I have not had the luck of getting a pet when I'm out of dice that's it

The gameplay is mildly entertaining, the controls are simple, but the reason for 1 star, is the amount of attempted packages they try to force down your throat everytime you run out of dice, or log on. I have to wait 2 minutes for all the forced BS to stop popping up before I can even get to the actual game content... absolutely ridiculous!

The game used to be enjoyable but now you can't complete much of anything without paying. Even paying rarely gets you what you need to complete side goals. Reaching out to support is pointless because they want access to the storage or to the camera roll and it tells you to grant permissions. I have all permissions granted and still can't supply support the requested info. I'm uninstalling the game due to these things.

3 mins of click bait every time you load. Played for 28 days, the format is the same as many many others out there. Main reason I don't like this game... Forces you to watch approx. 3 mins of pop ups every time you load, then, sticks a "full screen" button over the build button and when you accidentally press it guess what..that's right, watch all the pop ups again, why? Why would any mobile game have a full screen button when the game is already full screen, oh yea, to hope you spend money!

I absolutely loved this game and played it for a LONG time (nearly 13k crowns), but the latest update has made it completely unplayable. It overheats my phone within 2 minutes of opening it, making it impossible to do anything in game or on my entire phone until I close it. No other app does this, and as soon as its closed, suddenly my phone is completely fine 🤷🏼‍♂️

not sure how people say this is a free game.... yes can be played for free but definitely isn't a FREE game, currently 3 days away from albums closing and they've made it nearly impossible to play without spending money,therefore isn't FREE, even the wild pass... yeah prizes are great,if the targets were realistic to reach without having to buy! if you wanna play a free game this ain't it... if you wanna play an addictive game and don't mind spending some £'s then yeah good game

I am not the kind of person who pays to play. I don't mind watching some videos to play. But the videos went away and tech support was not helpful. I feel like they did this on purpose to get you hooked and then force people to pay. I don't appreciate being forced to do anything. I'm uninstalling this game. Good luck to all.

Played this game a lot. It is extremely rigged and, not only that, about half the time if you spend money you will not get everything in the offers and have to contact support which can ruin your run in a game heavily built on timers. If you're going to play this one, don't spend and if you do spend make sure to check that you're getting everything you're supposed to.

ok...I had to revise...NEVER spending a dime on this game again. I actually made it through the "first" 10 levels and was able to "adopt" my pet but its a scam...you can't keep it...and there are several sets of 10 levels. Went through all of that and logged in to see an egg again. Also if you're trying to defeat Chunk know that at the last chest the "hits" impact is decreased significantly.

Purchasers Be Wary. I enjoyed this game, even tho it's a bit repetitive & lacks rewards you really want (unless you pay). Here's my issue...I made a $2.99 purchase, game told me there was an error; I tried again 30 secs later. That went thru, but I was also charged for the 1st! (a $2.99 purchase to use pearls to gain more rewards. No one could have bought twice!). I contacted support and was told no refund even tho game was at fault. Said I rec'd what I pd for. Read reviews! Game steals your $.

Fun until the last week or so. The game loads extremely slow, and never fully finishes loading actually active buttons. I think there's probably too much front end offer pop-ups overloading it. Buttons load and "click" when you tap but nothing happens. Roll button doesn't even click. The number of offer pop-ups has always been overwhelming, especially when you use up the # or rolls you have your bet set to, then you get all the offer pop ups, change the bet level, use them up, same offers popup.

this isn't a game, let me be clear. this is a gambling app with engineered pressure to make you pay real money for dice rolls. it will force you to sit through a dozen popups for purchase packs before it lets you roll 5x and you're done, upon which it throws all of the purchase options at you again. none of the events can be completed without paying. genuinely one of the least rewarding ""games"" i've ever played.

Conned into playing this game through an app that's supposed to earn you cash. This game is terrible. 100% scam. Watch ads and never get the rewards. The game assaults you with pop-up ads trying to sell you stuff from their store. Support tells you you never watched the ad, even though you did. Then they keep blaming you and tell you to restart your phone even though you just restarted it. So you restart it again and watch another ad and still don't get your reward. Don't just walk away. Run.

The most addictive game I've played in my life keeps you on your toes the whole time; some challenges appear unrealistic, but with excellent help from Super Play, everything adjusts very fast. Hollywood Trail is too easy now 🤣. The Kingdoms are still very expensive. The game is really excellent. I am also playing Domino Dreams, the same very addictive, excellent game.

I LOVE this lil game. It's so cute & it's actually fun. I love the fact that you can buy more dice if you want to, but you dont have to like most games. I love the fact that it doesn't take forever to level up as well. I would def recommend this game to other people. update 7/4/26: I still love the game, but after making a couple purchases everything becomes SO expensive! I can't afford to pay $50+ for the packages. Please make the prices more reasonable in the higher levels!!

In the last month or so my opinion of this game has gone down. I don't like being forced into the jet pack duel things. I don't play to win big or be number 1. I play because I thought it was a cute game and it was fun, at first. But again, with the tournament, it shows and updates your number in real time, with a noise and a great big arrow. Makes it too competitive, more stressful, and less enjoyable. Given that I've spent actual money on this game I'd hate to quit but if this keeps up I will.

I find the game to be quite addictive and fun , it does seem to take awhile to load and Ive found when building your board it is REALLY expensive you get very limited dice to play with. I understand some people pay for the extra dice but I simply refuse , no hate towards anyone or anything with the game just a personal preference. Be good to see the prices come down a little bit or maybe introduce a builders bash where U could get up to 50% off the board.

I mostly like this game, but it tries entirely too hard to force players to buy stuff, with easily a dozen pop up ads for paid content before you are allowed to actually play. This happens EVERY TIME one opens the game. Only about one or two of them will ever have any relevance to the gameplay. Seriously, just consolidate all the paid content to one button, STFU, and let players play in peace.

glitchy and laggy when you first open the app but catches up after a couple minutes once the micro transaction suggestions and stuff loads in. the game is surprisingly oddly satisfying with the animations and graphics. I do find it annoying how often it throws them up on the screen once your rolls are lower and almost empty. I also don't see any benefits to being part of a team in this game. otherwise its better than I expected

pretty fun overall. Tons of pop ups though, prompts to pay to play type of perks. Literally can't see how anyone without buying finishes a trail. Played a ton last week (did not buy). Stuck mid 9/10 chests. ugh. Im not one that pays to play so truthfully can't see playing much longer, seems you need to pay to win.

I've been playing for years I have several pets and am far in the game, I have to close and reopen the game at least twice! It's like the buttons are heavy, like the game was designed to move slow and the longer you play the worse it gets! The game lags and freezes A LOT! I have even gone in the settings and changed it to performance over graphics - no difference! Some of these challenges are timed! Slow to load and the annoying pop-up's! Also lvl 10 for a pet now is greedy! It is not my phone!

the game itself is fun! cute graphics, lots of things to keep you entertained. however, the practice of locking users out of watching ads to get items once they make a purchase is shameful. and gaslighting users by saying it doesn't happen is unethical. I thought my game was messed up but upon looking around it seems common knowledge that making a purchase, no matter how small, removes ad rewards to force your hand into spending more money. very not cool.

Too difficult and unrealistic now. with the new updates, it makes it almost impossible to move forward or achieve goals without purchasing more dice. changing the trails to 15 cases instead of 10, or the amount of steps you must take to get to each chest.. both unrealistic to achieve now. you literally cannot make any progress in this game unless you spend money.. and this is embarrassing to say but I know I've spent over $400-500 on this game over the last year. Need to go back & make easier.

Fun little game...Great way to pass the time, but the rewards are far, far less than the costs. Growing a pet, for example, costs hundreds of pieces of pet food, yet the reward for passing a level is 1 piece of pet food. Seriously, 1 piece. It's very discouraging to work for days or weeks toward multiple rewards, only to run out of time because it is impossible to earn as much as you need to succeed. A significant increase in rewards would make this a 5 star game.

I've been playing Dice Dreams for a while now, and it's become one of my favorite mobile games. The graphics are colorful and fun, the gameplay is easy to learn, and there's always something to do. I enjoy building my kingdom, collecting cards, and competing with friends. The game keeps me coming back with daily rewards, events, and challenges that make it exciting without being overly complicated. One thing I especially like is that you can make progress even with short play sessions.

Game cheats. I've been playing this game for a year or 2 now and I can't complete any challenge without spending money. Also, when I bring problems to their attention I never get the problem fixed before the time runs out on challenges. I've spent a couple of hundred dollars I'm sure. They have tried by giving little incentives for things that mess up, but it never equals what I loss due to a glitch. I'm finally done with them.

I've been playing it for a while, and it is quite a simple game, most of it is completely chance based and most goals are just out of reach if you never buy any pack for extra dice or other things. so when I bought the pack with a wild card to finish my set and get 50.000 dice rolls the game decided not to give me the wildcard and their customer support is almost non existent only AI, just horrible.

I love this game. The addiction is real. only issue i have is how once you start making purchases, the prices get really high for low quality prizes. And how when you get far in, you can't win any missions without spending. Really other than the prizes not matching the price like making an expensive purchase just to keep getting stickers that you already have over and over. So that purchase was just like giving yall free money with nothing in return sometimes. Can't get enough of this game tho

This game forced your hand to buy rolls. I was playing and getting a lot of ads and in turn getting free rolls but then I made a small purchase not intending to buy anymore and suddenly my ads disappeared and it's impossible to make any sort of progress as it takes 8 hours just to get a full refill in turn forcing you to buy rolls just to actually play the game.

to be quite honest, I have been playing this game for months and it's REALLY fun. the best thing is no ads. everyday is something new to discover. everything in there is fun, and there are always other stuff to accomplish rather than just completing kingdoms. the only things that are sort of negative-ish are these: 1. some of the things in there are like p2w things, and if you want a lot of stuff offhand you have to pay money, and sometimes its not very cheap. 2. lag occurs very often.

ive played this game for a while now and im uninstalling. Ive spent a lot of money because you get to a point where you need one single item to win a large prize and you never get it but then, of course, right before the time is up on this side game that one item you need becomes available to buy in a package. On the side trail game. I got 9 of 10 chests and used 100,000 spins AFTER the 9th chest and only got 1/4 of the way to the 10th. Thats crazy! You can't win!

The colors are pretty, but the ads are ridiculous. The deals are not very good either. The ads are also deceptive. They make you believe that you will get one thing, but they will not give it to you. Pets, for instance, they advertise that if you buy you will keep your pet but it is not true. The last level for keeping your pet is ridiculously hard and even with a hundred dollar purchase you cannot keep your pet. It also runs slower compared to the ios version. Not laggy, just slower.

I wish the developers would make some of the game board builds were slightly animated when they are touched, after a build is completed - such as a peon using 1 or 2 of them. Also ,I wish they would make the peons a little more interactive and animated when they are touched and it would be nice to "earn some rewards (like dice or coins) for interacting with the some of the peons a (certain) number of times".

I've been given the run around for 7 days regarding a glitch/error that occurred on an event. I've been BEYOND patient, trying to let them correct the mistake but they are adamant there wasn't one. I've spent nearly $200 in this game and they'd rather give me ai generated responses than fix a simple problem.
