I like the concept. The gameplay is addicting, HOWEVER, there are too many pop ups and ads pushing you to spend money. It gets repetitive and boring after a while. I like the auto rolls, but I wish there were other ways to speed everything up. It takes too long to Fight, Attack, Steal, and Raid even though I like the concepts of each activity.

Super cute animation and music. I love the different aspects to gameplay, especially the adorable stickers. The only thing I would want to change is how often the various offers pop up. Sometimes I only have a few minutes between classes, and half that time ends up spent closing adds. They're much more convenient on the sides. I'm far more likely to purchase extras if they're not intrusive. Thank you and I'm happy to keep playing!

This game is a waste of time, unless you want to make purchases along the way to make a barely fun game slightly more fun. To make things worse, they have MULTIPLE pop ups, trying to get you to buy useless dice rolls or whatever you need to get a quest done. I refused to buy anything, so finishing a quest in the time given was nearly impossible. But you get SO close to finish, buying becomes kind of tempting. The pop ups not only show up when you log in, but also when you run out of dice.

Definitely a great way to spend idle time. I love the little buildings in each Kingdom but they sure do get expensive. It's still fun though. The only thing I don't like are all the pushes for in app purchases. It seems like the whole side of my screen has been lined before. I do appreciate the great deals but I'd rather they be in the store for me to go look at or just pop up once. Other than that this game is great. The graphics are very nice, diverse kingdoms and such, very inclusive.

I've put about $23 into it, from that I was able to complete the Trail 2x, no more after that until the new one starts. The trail gets more difficult the 2nd time. Did 3 Tournaments, for one of the game challenges, I noticed each one was more difficult than the last to try and get to Top 3. 10 ads pop up anytime you open the game. If you complete the Dream Pass you have to repay the $5 for access to it again. Pet treats get harder and the Bubblegum is terrible. I wish I could get my money back.

I love the game. I've been playing it Since it came out & it's a Great game For the most part, Every once in awhile I Have technical issues with the game. It freezes, glitches or doesn't give me the rewards I earned or purchased now is one of those times. I spent quite a bit of $ purchasing in app purchases & it will not let me into the Trail to complete it. That's the main reason I made all of the purchases that I did. It's very frustrating paying for something & not getting it.

Got this game through Mistplay and I loved it at first. It helped me get a lot of points for MistPlay and it was adorable too. However, there are SO MANY "great deals" and "special offers" popping up constantly that it becomes enraging. I have to wait for the animations to play through before I can close it, and there are at least 5 of these every time it happens. Also, instead of fixing the issue, support claims it helps the game run smoothly!? LOL it slows gameplay and causes loading issues!

If you're looking for a game to play for a few minutes to kill some time, don't try this one. Every time you open this game, you're bombarded by in game pop ups (events, sales, progress, etc) BEFORE you can even play. I counted 8 before I stopped counting. The game itself is nothing special. Click the button, spin, kind of progress, etc. Just an overall pointless and not very fun

Gameplay is great if you keep it casual. However, trying to achieve certain things is frustrating. 1. Pets are the worst. I may be the only one (but I doubt it), but the only way to actually get to the forever stage is lots of purchasing. 2. The 15 or so ads and events every single time you open the app are needless. 3. The sticker albums are virtually impossible to complete. Once you have 10 or so remain, expect to get nothing but duplicates. 4. Support tickets do nothing. No response.

Purchase is required to complete the trails (side quests). It's an okay time killer but the given rolls run out much too quickly. Also, even after playing for more than a year I've never completed the "sticker" collection. After playing this game for over a year I am going to uninstall it. When it costs billions of coins to level up, and goes for days without giving shields so that your progress is destroyed, you take the hint and QUIT! This game will run you broke.

I really enjoy this game. However, because of the truly egregious amount of in game pop-ups (literally before you can even start to play there's 6 pop-ups on opening, and then any time you run out of dice, you get 4 more) I can't give this game any higher rating. If the devs choose to fix this by either removing pop-ups or making them an option to turn off, I'll definitely edit my rating.

I've really been enjoying this game and it's really cute. I do get frustrated with alllllllll the pop ups for micro transactions trying to sell you more rolls and/or whatever other limited time side quest promotions are going on at the time. I wouldn't mind them so much if it was 1 or 2, but it's like 6 or more every time I open the game and then a couple more when you run out of rolls. It's just a lot.

I really like this game, but it has too many pop ups. I would rather select one of the icons to pay for more dice than having them pop up automatically. I have to push the X on 8 pop ups before I can make can do anything else. Developer response: "If the dice multiplier doesn't exceed the total rolls, there won't be excessive pop-ups in the game, except during the initial launch. We swiftly run them as they're also choices for those who wish to prolong their playtime." 🙄👎I uninstalled game

It is a fun game to play. Customer service needs improving. Cons: I have a hard time actually getting good roles and every time I get close to completing my pet or a challenge, you begin to get times and most times I run out of it. Sucks to spend months accumulating on the album (it is not easy or even moderate), I got to 91% and it was closing. About 3 months of work about to be gone due to them trying to convince you to keep buying. And that's just it, you have to buy a lot to get higher.

Every time you use all your dice or complete a level, they pop up 5-7 ads to buy more stuff for the game. Overall, the game is fun & somewhat unique. However, if you want to play it continuously for a while, you'll need to buy options or wait an hour while your dice reload. The in app purchase notifications got so annoying, that I deleted the game.

The graphics are nice, and I didn't have any trouble with crashing or anything like that, but it's kind of boring. There's no skill involved excepting timing the slingshot when you're attacking someone's kingdom. Also, there's only room for 3 shields so when you get more than three it's like a wasted roll... I had a little fun playing at first, but it just got really boring, so I uninstalled it.

I love the game, it is fun. No ads which is wonderful. I would give it a 5-star but they have their own little packages you can buy, and 4-6 of those flash through every time you change screens. Very annoying. There should also be an option to remove/dismiss the piggy bank. This was a fun game. I would still love to play it but ever since the update it just freezes up after a roll or two.

I have been playing this game for a while. It has been a great distraction from stressors. I recently had multiple issues with purchasing items. When I talked with them, they were quick to respond each time (within around a 24-hour period). however, only one time was actually compinsated for the money lost, whereas with the other two, I was just told we value feedback even if not the greatest. I do not want to say anything bad, but I think that was wrong. I want free items, just whatI paid 4

Super cute and addicting! was my initial review. I've played it now for a few months, and though I still feel it is cute and addictinging, I am disappointed in the fact that you can't get too far without paying for it-no matter how often you play. I believe you should be able to COMPLETELY enjoy a free game for FREE. I've also seen a high level of manipulation on their part when it comes to dice rolls, which is frustrating. This app has great potential, however, I believe it needs some tweeking.

So far, I am addicted! I have been playing non stop since I downloaded, and really, I only made a 3$ in app purchase cause I wanted to, you can play almost straight through without running out of rolls or coin. EDIT- Now that I'm getting up past level 50, its getting to be really expensive if I wanna play longer than 2 times a day for 5 or 10 minutes. I am almost 90% done collecting my cards for a 25 grand dice win, but I keep getting duplicates, lots of them. Its depressing to not finish

Thus far, I really enjoy playing dice dreams! I love all the worlds people can enter, how you can interact with other players, and how there are always different ways to earn prizes. The only problem I've had with it thus far is that recently, I got second place in a tortament, but was able to get my prize. This doesn't occur often. However, the game glitched, and a new tortament began. However, it doesn't occur a lot, and overall, I would recommend this game.

I really loved this game, and it was fun until the last update. Game keeps on crashing, and when you exit out and go back in, you lose all your progress. I just recently won 2nd place in the tournament and was awarded 1.8k rolls for it, had exit the game and when i came back it was gone. Update: changed to 4 star review. They were able to send a compensate me for the mistake but the game still freezes at times

Fun. Relaxing. Not a gazillion ads! I'm updating my review. I do still enjoy playing the game but last night I purchased a $19 boost in the deep sea dive so I could use at least PART of the rewards I had (it is wrong to be forced to make a purchase to use them plus another $50 purchase to finish it out). I was able to complete my kingdom, had over 10,000 rolls and was 3rd in the tournament when the game started buffering and wouldn't stop. Ended up losing EVERYTHING. No support help.

Love this game!! Always has cute and fun little mini-adventures/ quests/ challenges that keep things interesting, and the graphics are great! Only issue I ever have is that there is some lagging at times and start-up of the app can be a bit slow; additionally, if I were to give any 'critique' of any kind: my Daily Rewards/Gifts within the game sometimes do not load at all for that day, and there is nowhere to open up the calendar to show when they will be ready again, or if you've missed a day!!

Such a fun, addictive game but it has an obnoxious amount of pop-ups prompting you to make in-game purchases. As soon as you open the game, you can't play until you've exited 6-10 purchase prompts. Then when you run out of rolls, they automatically pop-up all of the purchase prompts again. If I just closed the prompts 30 seconds before, then completed a few turns, I don't want to see the ads again that soon. There are so many purchase buttons plastered along the edge of the screen at all times.

I was enjoying the game! However, right as I'm about to win the pictures challenge for 25k dice, amongst other challenges ending in less than 6 hours, I now can't open the app! I have 98% of the pictures, 8/10 of the treasure chests, etc. I'm going to be really frustrated if I can't access the game and thus lose all of my rewards. Not cool and not fair! Besides this experience, I would've given this game 4 or 5. 😮‍💨

Love the game EXCEPT for all the advertisements pushing you to buy more on the game before you've even taken your first roll of the day! Love the extra rolls and the side games. I just find the ads annoying. I purchase when I decide, not because the game prompts me every time I turn around. The game is fun and suspenseful. I wish we could get revenge more than a couple of times and the maximum number of shields should increase every few levels to make it harder to burn down a building.

I don't get this game at all. You click buttons, get coins, build, get rewards, then occasionally attack other players. It's like a watered down version of other games but with worse graphics. There are so many clouds, I never get to see what's building, and that's probably the only part that would appeal to me. Loads pretty fast, plays quickly, good layout. Just nothing much to the game.

This game is so cute and highly satisfying! I was skeptical when I downloaded it. I figured it would stop being very easy or rewarding after a little while, but I've been playing for a couple of months now, and it's still giving me lots of in game rewards and incentives. I love the little characters and the whole design of the game. No ads, other than they try to get you to buy their own stuff, but that's easy to ignore. No purchases necessary to have fun! :-D ♡

I absolutely LOVE the game, and I am addicted to playing it. However the problem I am having, is I've bought a few packages for $.99 and was supposed to get a free package afterwards and I haven't been able to get the free package. It continues making me buy the first package for $.99. Also, every time I play (or buy a package) it kicks me off the game repeatedly. Even in the middle of free spins or attacks. Especially After getting on and exiting all the ads it's kicks me off entirely.

I really like this game a lot. While it's obviously a copy of Monopoly Go, it has made some great changes and stands apart. That being said, I have to give it a 3 star rating because the mtx (is $30 still micro?) is atrocious and predatory. You are bombarded with every single offer one after another each time you launch the game. You can't click on anything and play the game. It literally takes 5 minutes to get through closing everything. Not only then, but each time you run out of dice too.

Love the game. It's why I'm giving 3 stars instead of 1. Super fun, super cute, easy concept, takes just a few moments a day to play. My issue is their help team. Tickets go missing or don't get any form of resolution or response, just automated responses. I've reached out 3 different ways to try and get a purchase issue where I didn't receive the items resolved despite having all things needed,and no response. Buyer beware of potential for loss with no resolution.

This game reminds me of coin master but so much better! I love the graphics, the competition, and the addictive qualities. You can play free and actually advance in this game. I have to admit though that I have purchased a few small packs. There's always something to do, from building up your towns to advancing in the constant tournaments. A+++ 100%!!! Edit: a month later and I'm still playing this game every day. I also had a small issue with a purchase and reached out. Great customer service!

Great game, fun to play.. My only complaint is it's really slow loading most days because they have way too many offers that have to load. Also, sometimes when making a purchase, it completely kicks you out of the game so then you have to reload it and sit thru all those things loading.. Other than that, it's fun to play, graphics are great, and the little dice guys are adorable.. Highly recommended!!

This game is pretty fun. The graphics are cute and not cheap-looking. The game-play, itself, is like Coin Master, in that you get a certain number of rolls, and those rolls can either give you coins, let you attack, or let you steal. You use coins to build up the buildings on your current gameboard (each level is a new gameboard). So yeah, very similar, but much better than Coin Master, in my opinion.

This is one of the best games ever created in my opinion! The only experience in this game that is remotely close to being a negative experience is that, for example: if I'm using a 25 roll boost and no longer have enough rolls left to use that high of a boost, every time that happens I have to either skip or exit out of or watch no less than 4 ads. And that can end up being 5 or 6 times. That tends to "suck". But I would take nothing away from the game because of it. Overall... SUPER AWESOME!!!

I've discovered the game doesn't deserve even one star. This game has been troublesome from the beginning. It takes a long time, up to ten minutes, just to load. After it has loaded it doesn't respond correctly. The dice dropping might as well have parachutes on. Just once has the game set up for the slingshot then the game froze out. The screen is either freezing or the game is getting dropped. I don't know why this is happening. I've checked everything I can on the phone.

Love the game. It is addicting and fun to play, however today I experienced my first glitch. I've admittedly spent an embarrassing amount of money on this game and made a purchase today for the Genie offer...The purchase went through (I have the receipt) but then an error popped up immediately. I didn't receive any of my items, even after closing the app and rebooting as the pre written troubleshooting tips say to do. I've messaged the company and hoping for a resolution! Otherwise I'd rate 5.

Been playing this game well over a year now and it's been great. But, I've been having lots of issues lately. The lag is so intense. I have to force close the app sometimes to make it work for a while till it starts lagging again. I've also had issues where I'll buy a package which your receive 2 free gifts after purchase. But, what would happen is during the purchase is processing the whole app will crash and I'll just receive what I purchased but not the 2 free ones. They have reimbursed.

Love the game but there's definitely some complaints. First off with the pet, unless you spend your way through the game you have no chance in keeping or really even leveling up your pet. I've been trying like crazy and I can't even make it to level two let alone all the way to ten. That's ridiculous. Secondly, too many pop ups. Upon entering the game and running out of rolls, if I want to see the pop ups I'll click them myself to see the options, I don't need 10 different pop ups in my face.

The game glitches & you have to try for days to play, even if you reinstall the game. By the time you get back on, your town is destroyed & your pet progess reverts back. I feel like it's impossible to get all the stickers even if you join the sticker groups. The game penalizes you for spending money, the more you spend the more it charges for the next package. It's still hard to add friends, can you at least add your teammates, no. Still can't get more than 2 dice as a gift. Disappointing!

This game is a good way to unwind ... It's addictive and found myself making a lot of purchases. The annoying thing is the glitches, I've been losing dice without anything happening. Sometimes, when I hit the bonuses, it freezes, and I don't receive the rewards. That's frustrating and unfair since the purchases are not cheap!

The game is fun. My biggest pet peeve is having to constantly close/decline the offers to buy more rolls, coins, etc, each and every time you run out of moves. I get there are offers to buy stuff, I've used them occasionally, but to force feed ALL of them back to back and not let me do anything else until I get through them is super annoying. Perhaps offer once, and if the player declines, don't show the offer again. Let them go look if they're thinking of making an app purchase.

I love this game, but I have one issue. Every single time the video mania is available to watch ads to get free rolls, it takes it away before the allotted time is expired. I lose out on so many free rolls and wish this issue could be resolved! I have notified support, but nothing has been done to help this issue or can not open the feedback in the game. Also, the trail challenges and to complete the album is almost impossible cause you run out of time to complete and can't always get free rolls

Honestly... I've been playing this game for a while now. Its a great game to play. BUT the continued "suggestive selling" prior to game play take the fun out of it. There are icons on the left and right once you finally enter the game so it's always there to purchase if need be. But to go through 8 screens before playing is a bit much. Take the fighting mechanism off because it also lowers the enjoyment. The higher you achieve the less you receive...go figure. .

Fun and easy to use, was my first impression but after playing for a while I noticed there are glitches that cause "sorry something went wrong" messages and kick you out of the game. When you return to the game, you've lost your progress and points causing you to play the same level again. It is frustrating, especially after spending money in game for more rolls or upgrades.

Loved it.... Past tense...The longer I play, the harder it is to win anything without spending a ton of money!! For example, this current Pet story. I am at the last level with 5 days to go. The first section requires over 1500! There is absolutely no way to accomplish this without buying all the cookies. And even if I wanted to spend hundreds of dollars to do that, you can't. Another example, the amount of space between the chests on the trails is ridiculous. It's almost not worth it do better

I love the game. I play every day. The challenges are great! I have to lower my rating though. I keep getting an error 255. I don't know what that is. I have Uninstalled, reloaded, and waited. Nothing works. I am so disappointed. I lost all my progress on one of the challenges. The game just freezes when it does load. I finally have decided to Uninstall. It is not my network or device so don't try blaming it on that. All my other apps work just fine.

I like the mechanics and stuff, but once you reach a certain level, things slow down drastically. You then have to rely on perfect timing of building and things to gain enough resources to continue progression. DO NOT spend money. It will be very tempting to helo speed up progress, BUT as soon as you do, they throttle the rewards from dice rolls, trails, etc. in what I can only assume is an attempt to get you to spend even more. Was fun for a while, now all it does is try to get me to spend more

fix the game bugs. This game don't even load me in no more. I've tried everything. Rebooting my phone. Checking for updates. Turning off wifi, keeping data running, turning on airplane mode then off and on to wifi. Sliding out all of my apps on my phone. Rebooting a hundred times. Literally the only thing that fixes this bug of even loading into the game daily now is uninstalling the game and then reinstalling and have THAT only work for one day. It's not my signal. It's not my phone.

This has been one of my fave games for a couple years now. However, recently I'm noticing a lot of inconsistencies (they could have been there all along, I'm just now noticing them). Example: the items that you need to collect rarely let's you get the exact amount & before you know it, they change it & you get 0 credit for what you did hve; also 1 time rec 10 pts, the next it's 20 pts (I always play x10). When you win free DICE they say you have won X # of rolls. Not true. May be time to move on

When I first found this game and started playing, it instantly became my favorite game. I played it religiously. But after maybe 3-4 updates ago, I barely get to play. It's constantly kicking me out or closing out on me. Sometimes it will go to the beginning loading screen when I'm trying to watch a Ad to earn spins. When I get the free spins (The Disco Room) it will boot me out and I have to go through the beginning process of all the ads and advertisements only to find out I've lost my spins.

The game and graphics itself are great,but the popup ads are getting ridiculous. The game is also getting expensive to play,and if you dont pay,you don't get a lot of extra help. For instance,the recent album in the last 50+ stickers, I have only received one new one a super, and that's it. I've also reached out to them about a glitch in the game during a purchase that cost me an extra $20 that I have yet to get anything resolved. I also had an aunt join the game, and I never received my gift.

I've been playing this game for a while now and it's starting to quickly lose my interest. WAY TOO MANY ADS. When you log on to play you have to skip through at least TEN pop-up purchase options, which then crowd your screen as you try to play. With every 'update' it just gets worse and I'm quickly losing interest. I can see a game offering one or two purchase gimmicks, but this game is becoming nothing but ads and gimmicks. No thanks. I'm done.

When this game first came out, it was a lot of great fun... After they changed how the sticker album works and added a bunch of stuff, it's turned into a "pay to win" scheme once you get to a certain level or if you want to complete the sticker albums. The "deals" are RIDICULOUS - they expect me to pay $200+ for rolls and sticker packs! They've become extremely greedy and thrown off the balance of the game and it's just not fun anymore after 3 1/2 years of playing...

Fun so far on day 3 of play. Quick progress w/o having to pay $ or wait ages for rolls to build, which rewards you with more money and more rolls so you can move at a nice pace. ETA: the farther in, the more side quests open up. Play it right, you can keep your rolls coming in quickly and avoid the pop-ups to buy them if you don't have the multiplier set higher than the number of rolls that will be left. Too many ads to buy stuff makes you lose interest. Get rid of some ads or limit them a bit!

I just started playing this game through TesterUp and I have to say that this is the best game I have played so far in game queue. It's easy to play, has really good graphics, and there are lots of mini games and challenges to complete, in addition to the dice game. And no outside ads that interrupt your game play every other second. There are in-game ads for in-game purchases, but they aren't annoying or constant, and they often give you some freebies with the in-game purchases.

The amount of ads that come up to buy in game stuff every time you run out of dice, open the game, switch from the trail, etc. is ridiculous. I get about 8 to 10 pop ups every single time I do any of the above!! That's not an exaggeration. My friend who place on Apple doesn't get nearly as many. I'm debating on uninstalling. Only reason I don't is my friend plays with me.

I changed my 5 stars to 3. It seems like every time I spin a large number on the trails that it never seems to reflect that on the little guage, it barely moves on the right and it wont let you count how many more moves you need to get to the end. I understand that they want you to make purchases, but it seems like if you don't, then you don't seem to progress as much. UPDATE: I removed a star. You need to get rid of the "mucinex booger monster" trail. It's impossible to break thru the wall.

5 Star for me. Love the graphics and giggling little minions. The rock, paper, scissors, shoot fights are so cute! Level up is easily achieved, with lots of bonus and rewards with extends play time without purchase, where other similar games cut you off quickly unless you "pay". I will be investing in this game for sure. It's a "Happy" game for the young and old. If you want a complex game tho, look elsewhere.

Love playing this game it has a few glitches but I can play for hours very enjoyable. UPDATE. I have been very disappointed in your game lately. The way it freezes up or disconnects when I have a big win. Especially when you have the watch video for 2x the win. It kept freezing and dropping off. Until the promotion was over. Very frustrating. Some people play for relaxation or fun. Not all about money. Just be fair to your Still happening 😡🤬

I don't play any online games, but my husband got me hooked on this one. I get on multiple times a day and accomplish quite a bit. The tournaments are a fun add on to the game. I would give 5 stars if the multiple purchase offers didn't pop up every time I run out of rolls. That's a bit annoying. I'm also disappointed that I've made purchases and now the cost of everything has gone up. Shouldn't i get better deals for being a loyal player??

I love this game. But I would be remiss if I didn't say this. 7 pop-ups when the game sets, i counted tonight. It's too much. The banners are on the sides, let us explore on our own. Or have one card that shows a brief bit of them all and if we choose we can look or not. But red Xs and arrows. So troublesome. And again when you get low on rolls 🫨.

Love the game but sometimes it doesn't save my progress when I shut it off or it shuts itself off, which it does frequently. Also the pop-ups at the start of the game are annoying but usually offer good deals you can purchase and some really good free stuff too so it makes up for the annoyingness Eta: It hasn't randomly shut off 100 times in the last few days so I'm hopeful that that issue has been fixed. When it's working right, this game is definitely one of my top 2 favorite games to play.

Guys. I really do enjoy this game, more them I thought I would. But. When I open the app and have to wade through 8 to 10 pop-up screens every time, there's an issue. It slows down gameplay and makes me not want to play at all. Can't we maybe just cut down on that a tiny bit? Overall lots of fun and the graphics are pretty cool, too.

Love this game! Love the contests! Love the little guys!!! Can we only have the pop up adds to buy more turns once a game and not every time I run out of dice rolls. Can I pick who I steal from? I can pick who to attack. Still playing the game but the higher you get the more expensive each level is. You dangle cool stuff, like a new pet, but you make it so hard to get and so expensive and I either spend the money or lose out on the cool stuff, so why continue?

Only thing keeping this from getting no stars is the art style is cute. But every time I log into the game, I'm bombarded with ads. And then when I can finally play the game, the same ads are all over the screen as reminders. And then once I'm out of dice, I'm AGAIN bombarded by all the ads. On top of that, it has to remind me of all the event rules over and over. I spend more time clicking out of pop ups than actually playing the game. I've tried to give this game a chance but time to uninstall

I absolutely love this game! The sounds and colors are captivating and that is exactly how the developers want it. With every neat game, you have to invest if you want to progress. It seems that the further I go the more expensive it becomes in regards to their "deals". It's like handing them my paycheck if I want to get the dice. Plus you can tell they set their algorithms to offer little to no dice. What is most annoying, is the 15 pop up promos "deals" they throw up in your face.

Great game. It's super easy to learn and get started with an really quick to get hooked on!!! Plus there are many ways they reward you for doing things in the game. Like this review now is a quick example to use of the different types of rewards you can earn just for playing. When I ran out of spins they offered me to earn free spins if I leave a review for them. So I should be getting 25 free spins for leaving this review when I return to the game right SuperPlay? Overall it's a great game!!!

This game is cute and a good time waster, but I cannot give it more stars as it is currently. Just now when I opened it, there are 12 pop ups you have to close every time you open it. Then, once you run low on dice? Another 5-7 pop ups that you have to close again! That are the same from when you opened it the first time! Not to mention the missions with items you collect, but you cannot pass the missions without paying something. (Don't worry, you get more pop ups for those too). Potentially ok

You spend more time closing pop-ups trying to sell you things than you do actually playing the game. Open the game? Pop-ups. Run out of dice? Pop-ups. Every single possible offer they're running, every single time. It's maddening. I'll deliberately not use my last roll to avoid setting it off. I don't want to open the game sometimes because I don't want to have to close like 10 things in a row. Their goal is to make me spend $$, but instead I want to uninstall the game!

One of the funnest games I have found with NO STINKING ADS! There are pop ups when you run out of energy to refill but click through them unless u want to purchase...there are lots of ways to refill, plus you can play a long time before running out! I actually ran out of my energy before I ran out of energy on the game 🤣 (that dont happen often though).. Give it a try! Takes 30 minutes to get going good, then ur off!! Con.. it takes forever for the dice to refill

It's a decent game, nothing super exciting, ok to pass the time. But the amount of in-game pop-ups is so annoying. I'm not talking ads for other games. It is all the in-game purchases and little side quests etc. the amount of time it takes to open the app and finally get to play the game is so irritating. Constantly having to find the close button or back out of the pop-ups takes so much time, not worth playing in my opinion.

Do not download! This is is one of the biggest scam games I have come across. Where do I begin? They have these tournament type things that you can win dice and coins for. I have come in first place 2 times now and have not received a reward for it. It just happens to glitch out the 2 times when I come in first? I don't think so every other time when I come in a lot lower it gives me my reward. Also the dice you have you can use a multiplier like 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 25, 50, 100, or 200.

While the game is very fun and easily playable without spending money. I do have a problem with the rather excessive pop up "purchase" opportunities that continuously pop up over your screen when u either run out of dice, or have less dice than ur bonus. If it only happened once per say 2 hrs it would be less annoying. It really is irritating otherwise and does the opposite of encouraging me to spend money on the game. Otherwise I am very much enjoying the game so far.

Upon opening the game, you're bombarded with ads, wanting you to buy buy buy! Not only that, both sides of the game are filled with ads and this is all unnecessary and so is clicking out of 20 ads just to play the game. When you actually get to the game, it's just another tip off of the same type of board games like Board Kings, for example. It's okay but turns into a bore fest. Stop filling the game with ads and let us actually play upon boot up!

I really love this game, having a lot of fun playing it. Only problem is they have a customer service contact message service & 3 times now I have experienced a glitch that has caused me not to get my prizes , coins , and etcetera. I just got a treasure chest on a trail mini game consisting of 1 million coins , some dice & a few other things, and before I was rewarded the game glitches and I didn't get it. Game is great but there needs to be a way to avoid these type of issues.

The black Friday bonus game that you win a ton of decent prizes keeps disappearing and when it does come back several hours later your progress is gone. I am over the game glitching also and going to home screen during the middle of playing. Someone needs some better programmers. Way too many issues!!! Also the amount of popups when loading (SEVEN) is a bit extreme. Love the game but it's all too much!!!!

Love it 98% Wonderful, the issue I have with it at all is the freebies they give on their Facebook page. It expires too quickly. Some of us can't keep checking to see if anything has been posted. It should be available for a longer time period. You are playing and need some rolls, you hope there is a bonus. Yes there is, awesome until you follow it back and it has expired, after only being posted a few hours. Everything else, excellent including support. Yes, i shouldn't complain if free. Lol

Love the game, BUT, unless I spend a huge amount of money, I run out of rolls, or the pet will not load, I am in the middle of restoring my kingdom, and even when I have a couple rolls left here come all the Popups to buy,buy,buy! It does, get a bit annoying! I play for the fun of it!! But deleting the popups, every single time, every 5 minutes or so, it's starting to get more of a pain, than fun!

Update to original posting. Ads aren't too bad except when they crash & don't give you a reward: 60 second (or longer) ads for the "earn free money" games with the stupid bearded guy and/or the Koreans are the worst! I had fun playing DD without paying any money for 6 months, but it gets boring and repetitive at the higher levels. Best part was being able to use free coins to purchase premium sticker packs. With the new update, I can't do that any more. No reason now to keep playing.

The game itself is a lot of fun. I got lucky with some rolls, and enjoyed the little mini games. The biggest issue is the nonstop and intrusive popups of sales, offers, and events after rolling, logging in, etc. It's literally the same ones over and over. I KNOW about the offers. They are already on the screen and I've seen them too many times while trying to play. Reduce the popups to one: hey check these out! And don't show it CONSTANTLY. It takes away from the enjoyment of the game.

Love this game. My husband wanted me to download this to get him some free stuff. I was very skeptical at first because I thought thought it was going to be some boring dice game like normal, but it turned out to be something so addicting. Literally can't stop!! The only downfall is when I landed on one of the super spaces. This it didn't count, and I didn't get the move forward any further. Also, you always get these different events that pop up that you have to click out of all the time.

This game is strangely addictive & the more I play the more I like it. I love the little "peon" characters and that the idea of "fight" is rock paper scissors, a lot of thought has gone into the development of the boards. I have no complaints, other than maybe the "buildings" are a bit expensive but it's fun to make the $ to pay for them. Maybe develop an option to nudge us if someone is trying to fight so we could play that part live??

UPDATE: Ever since the update, the game has been doing a LOT better. Perhaps it was just the device I was using. The only thing I would like to point out is when a certain task is completed or increases in progress, the game will not let you interact anymore, thus having to close and open it again. However, it's not so bad since you're credited your rewards after you close and open it. Other than that, GREAT GAME TO PLAY!

It's ok if you want to waste some time. If you are competitive then you have to put a lot of money in the game because once you buy a package and end a tournament in the first 5 places, then you are upgraded "in another league" where people spend 1000$ or more, so you will also need to spend a lot of money. After purchasing several packages and continuing with the app, the app suddenly refreshed and I didn't receive the bonuses. Not to mention the app isn't always loading from the first try.

Literally the WORST Customer service, very expensive,greedy game. Prepare to pay hundreds of dollars. I started playing this game months ago. It was okay until you start advancing in the game. Things get more way more expensive. When you run out of dice, you'll be bombarded with ads with items you need to advance, I did not get the dice I won in a tournament. If you have a problem in the game.. Forget it! Customer support is useless and takes weeks to months to reply to 1 message.

All the pop ups after you run out of dice rolls is so irritating! It would be nice if that was taken off and then we could choose from the screen what we want to do next! Also the power ups costs too much! I'm not paying 50 dollars to break a piggy bank for 1 thousand rolls, that's ridiculous! Also when you do purchase something, it doesn't advance so you can get the free item that is next! If that is changed it would be 5 starts.

I will say that this is a fun game and I do play it all the time, but it does get annoying that when you get down to your last couple dice 4 to 5 offers pop up for you to buy more. Then after those couple, it will do it again. I also feel that 6 dice per hour until full is to long to wait in my opinion. That about 8 hours of waiting till full. Especially if you don't want to constantly buy dice just to keep playing. Which is probably their strategy to get money out of you.

I really enjoy playing this game. If we were able to trade "All" gold cards on certain days instead of one or two that we don't need...or allow us to purchase gold cards, this game would be perfect! Also, if you do make in-app purchases beware because not only will it become harder to naturally get what you need but the prices will increase & stay that way for a long time. I also don't like losing what we have fed our pet when we can't control what we win to feed them, that is wrong!

The in-app ads for Dice Dreams purchases are INCREDIBLY annoying. I have to click through at least 10 ads of varying lengths JUST to start playing the game. By the time I get through the gauntlet, I don't even want to play anymore. It's one of the reasons I avoid playing more than I do. And I do make purchases regularly. It's just too much with that first launch. I'm taking my rating down to 2 stars for this. If the game was not in Mistplay, I would uninstall it because it is that irritating.

The best game I've ever played. I usually don't play games on my phone. When I do, I get bored after a couple weeks and I uninstall it. I've had the game for over 3 months. Very content with it. The only thing that sometimes irks me is how at the beginning of the game upon launching the app, there are a whole bunch of selling points to purchase more dice packages and things like that. I noticed that as I further go along the game, there are more in app ads from Dice Dreams. This takes up time.

It's fun to play. Cute characters! I've had a lot of luck playing the game and hit big jackpots to keep my dice level high for the first couple of days. My partner playing the same game started having to wait for the dice reloads at level 6. You can pay to reload. Most deals are under $6 or just wait for a couple of dice to reload every hour. I will say big con is there are 5+ offers that always pop up when you start game and when you are out if dice. It annoying when you just want to play!

Very heavy on the push for purchases, every start up requires waiting thru about 9 ads for purchasing their special packages. Same thing when you get down to one spin. The entire screen for each offer, no way to skip, you have to close each ad one at a time as they appear. Devs could have a fun game, but it's ULTRA GREEDY. So it ruins the gameplay. It gets to basically 30 seconds of play, 30 hours of wait. Or pay a lot of cash, a lot.

Honestly, completely different from what I expected. I thought I was going to be like an eliminate the oncoming dice type of game, but it turned into so much more. Now, I'm not into blowing up, stealing, and taking over other's possessions. But this game has a little bit of everything; cards, rolling dice, rpg, and simming. Unexpectedly quite the experience.

Great for passing the time. As far as the game goes. I continue to play it. However it is super hard to trade stickers unless you befriend a lot of strangers and open them up to your FB. Also customer service is super slow. I have reached out to them 4 Times on the same matter. They have not responded once. So if you just want to play it's great. If you need help your on your own.

Only a 3 because they bombard you with ads to buy extras from them. Then in game if you get a free multiplier for the mini game trails the multiplier never shows up and you get normal numbers. That multiplier in the trails is just a lottery. Could be better if obtaining all the cards without paying was achievable, but it is not. Other than that, it is a good way to kill some time. Easy decent game.

YES ITS ALL KINDS OF FUN!!!! Once you get to the higher levels it's too hard to keep playing. Not everyone has money to keep buying dice. 8 die per hour is nowhere near enough to keep playing. Every link on Facebook I've tried to get free dice have not worked. Other than that I love the game. The graphic are great, the the characters are way cute. You just need to start putting free dice links that actually work.

I've been playing this game for awhile now. Completing challenges used to be easier, but now in order to complete stuff you have to spend money. I've had several issues with the game freezing and losing out on prizes. I reach out to customer service and don't hear back till after the events ended and lose what I should have had to complete to next level. Used to hear back from them within a day, but lately it's about a week later. It's a bummer because I used to really enjoy playing.

I like the game in general but there are way to many adds. And even if you purchase items it gives you a temporary boost in play time, but I quickly diminishes and you never stay up unless you buy more. Not to mention the incredibly high raise on prices. Wow! Piggy Bank went from $4.99 to $59.99 in one day. Come on guys! That's greed at its lowest. Contacted support, nothing. You'll never advance unless you spend real money. It's rigged.

Was loving the game. The only issue is can't play because it keeps popping up stuff. This is the only game I play that has so many links to buy stuff. I am not buying! So irritating for that stuff to constantly pop up. It takes 10 minutes to get through all those pop ups. No other game that I have played or do play doesn't pop up those things. It has a dedicated store or page for those. Especially hate waiting on the stickers it takes too long. Fix it and I'll up the rating.

Rip off of board kings. But the ads are RIDICULOUS! I can't even see the dice on the sides because of all the "special offers" plus every time you run out of dice they deceptively place an ad right where you were clicking! Well, Ads, plural. It's not worth it, I'm deleting it, just don't waste your time, it's fun but too many ads. Good grief. If it was fun without ads, I'd buy stuff... Duh.

Played the game for weeks before posting. Fun to play but takes forever to refill spins. Sometimes you can play for a while then other times you have to wait all day for your spins to regenerate. That's frustrating. Cute graphics. I have yet to earn a permanent pet, but not from a lack of trying. It's hard to get their food. Especially when you can't spin to earn anything because you're waiting all day.

Cute graphics and characters. Engaging. Full of the pay for extra rolls, etc that you can expect in current mobile games, but blessedly free of constant ads. Smooth running on my Galaxy S23 Ultra. A little limited in terms of variety of modes, or size of the sandbox, but that might be due to there being very little gaming skill necessary to play. I never believe that games that rely on randomness, in this case rolls of three 6-sided dice, are ever truly random.

Dice Dreams is more like a pop-up nightmare. Every single time you open the game, there they are: the pop-up offers. But they don't stop there: I played earlier and finished one kingdom and started the next and had to go through 7 (seven) sets of pop-ups of the same 3 (three) offers of more dice, more this or that. We know where to go to get more dice, no need to remind us each and every time ad nauseam. This is as bad as playing a game filled to the brim with ads. So annoying. Pls stop.

Revised my review down. When I started playing all the bonus packs were under $15 but once I'd bought a couple(can't finish any event without them), now they're starting at$25 up to $45. If I don't get any for a couple of weeks they go back down to$8. I'm about ready to delete, even tho I enjoy the game. Ridiculously high goals for rewards and not enough time to complete without spending well outside my budget. Just not worth it!

Honestly, this game is a hot mess in the best possible way. The simplicity of rolling dice to earn coins, but then having to attack, steal, or Rock-Paper-Scissors fight other players all in the efforts of building a kingdom. The graphics and mini-games/competitions only add to the fun. Regardless, I am here for all of it. This is totally not an entry towards the 1000 free dice, BTW.

The game freezes up frequently. The video mania many times doesn't work. It's fun when it runs as intended, but unfortunately, that's becoming a rare experience. Update 11-1-24 Yesterday I made it to 3 chest on the trail and didn't get the rewards. I've uninstalled and reinstalled the game this morning because it won't completely load. The game still won't load. It's frustrating because it is a fun game when it works. It's been hours and the game isn't loading.

The game bombards you with pop-ups and offers freebies but constantly pushes for payments for extra rewards. Progressing in the game requires these rewards, otherwise, you'll remain stuck at the same level. The 5 spins awarded every 50 minutes are worthless. While the game interface is impressive, its true intentions are solely focused on making a profit. It's best to avoid playing it unless you're willing to spend a lot of money. And definitely, don't let kids get hooked on games

Updated review after having quit the game. An easy, aesthetically pleasing, enjoyable game. But, to really compete and play more than a few minutes, purchases of more play are required, which is fine a little here and there. But, rather than reward paying users, and entice them to continue buying extras by extending their play enough to make it worth it, the more I bought, the quicker those extras got eaten up. Goals to acquire rewards thru play also got so unreachable with out extensive buys.

Getting sick and tired of paying money into this game, only for it to conveniently "crash" every single time I level up my pet, complete a trail, complete an album or something else. And then to have to reopen the app for all my progress to jump back 15 minutes. And the only way to make that progress back, is to pay more money. And when you stop paying into the game, you stop receiving anything.

I stopped playing for over a year, i remember loving the game, and I still really like it but I also quickly remembered why I quit. We do NOT need to get bombarded with all 97 of the offers every single time my dice balance drops. I end up closing the app and not playing because it's EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. my balance drops!! It's ridiculous, unnecessary, and I'm far less likely to make purchases when you annoy tf out of me. We know we can make purchases, really. We don't need harassed or annoyed!!

It's really fun! My only complaint is that I don't want to be on FB and that seems to be the only way to trade stickers . Then, I created a FB account, mind you, strictly for the game and when I attempted to join the sticker trading group they denied me!!! Having a great time with the game. Still wish there was more options on the stickers! There should be a variety ofvavenues that lead to becoming friends with other people on the game.mk

If you love pop-ups, this game is for you! Once you open the game, you get to sit through about 10 - 15 pop ups, granted you get coins /free rolls from a few of them. Once you run out of rolls, bring on the pop-ups! Even if you just roll once more, it's the same bloody pop-ups. It's a pretty decent time killing game for the most part, but just way too many damn things j have to close out of...

This is by far my favorite game. I've played for a few years and it just keeps getting better. The graphics, the gameplay and I get more game play and I dont have to make purchases to have fun playing. I just actually completed the last album and won 25,000 rolls. I've been unable to do that on other games. So fun! If u have an issue, write support and they will help you. 5 STAR GAME!!!!! I will add one sad detail...the trails are almost impossible of completing without making a purchase.

I love the game and play it with friends grom Facebook. It can be frustrating because it close alot sometimes. It can be very sporadic. When it's not freezing up or closing, it can be enjoyable. How can I get the game to stop closing continuously when I play. It's very frustrating to have to open it over and over multiple time just to try and play.

I only downloaded the app for another money making app. Overall I would enjoy the gameplay a lot more if not for the fact that as soon as you open the app you are bombarded with anywhere from 4-6 pop ups. Then if you run out of rolls, you get the same amount of pop-ups each and every time. It's incredibly infuriating as it just slows down what you're trying to do. That level of pop ups and their persistence, it's honestly predatory. You almost make the users feel obligated to send which is wrong

So far I'm loving this game, its been a while since I've started playing everything about it is absolutely amazing and you just couldn't get bored, it keeps you entertained for as long as you can play. Only thing I'm really upset about is the mini trail game. When I land on a spot that rewards dice rolls I never actually receive them and that's a shame. Same thing if I land on a spot that rewards coins. If it can get fixed asap that would be great. Overall awesome game!

Let me start with- I enjoy this game. The game play is entertaining and fun. There are millions of different deals to try to get you spend money. There also seem to be some hiccups when on the trails or auto roll. You do not get full count of movement or dice back. The only other issue I have seen is it is extremely hard to get the extra bonus points. It starts spend "any" amount and 50 units but I did not get the units after purchase.

Having a lot of fun playing this game. Love the fights. Just wish there was a no cash need.ed option for breaking open the piggy bank. I can't afford spending cash on games Been having more issues with things not working. Three tier trail never loads, is not an option to play, let's go button doesn't. Mission bar only seems to be available part time. This makes getting enough cookies for pet impossible, or is it meant to coerce me into spending money? Sometimes I wonder.

Love this game. Only 2 stars because it has to be the glitchiest game I've ever played. But when it does work properly the game is extremely entertaining. If the bugs get fixed, I would be more than happy to give 5 stars. Been playing for 2 years and game hasn't ever worked properly.Going on three days now and the app won't even open. This has happened a lot. It's been years now. PLEASE FIX YOUR APP.

Love this game!!!!! And would have given it a solid 5⭐'s had it not been for getting in a pretty good spot in the game and then end up having to delete the whole game..... I lost all my progress and wasn't able to get it back..... Sucks, because I had so much fun and loved the different scenes and architecture and characters...... Come on Domino Dreams get it together man!!!!!!!!!!

I actually like this game, but the reason I'm only giving it 2 stars is the ridiculous amount of ads to buy rolls and whatnot. I understand y'all are trying to make money and I get that, no problem, but to be constantly bombarded with 5-6 ads back to back to buy stuff after you use all your rolls, sometimes before you're even out. I don't mind ads, but for the love of everything that is good and holy, please slow your roll. It really makes me want to just delete the app.

It's fun to play at first, but then you have to pay to play basically. They push you way too much to buy, buy, buy. If you don't buy rolls after rolls, you might as well forget about playing as you level up, because once you get into higher levels, you can barely compete with any of the challenges they put out without having to spend more of your money for all these rolls, therefore making the challenges almost useless each and everytime you play, eventually making the game not fun anymore.

Too many pop-ups to the point it's obnoxiously irritating. All they are doing is trying to push you to buy the dream pass or events they have going for more dice and goodies (like you cant live without them), and you can't forget the piggy bank at 3.99 cause it's full! I think if I wasn't bombarded constantly the game might be okay, but it's a brain cell killing game, meaning it's rather boring and not at all fun, imo.

It's a good time passer game and it's very calming. The graphics are pretty good. The characters are really cute too. The only thing I have negative to say is the pricing to actually get through the levels and game boards. It starts out pretty reasonable to build the "kingdom" but as you move up the items get more and more pricey to complete. This game reminds me a lot of Board Kings.

Great game. I think it would probably be my fav of all time except the cost of buildings is ridiculous from the beginning. In other similar battle/steal games the prices didn't get so high until after about the 30th stage. Also, you can roll 30 times before you ever get to battle or steal. This is a game u would probably spend way to much money on but as is right now its just not worth it. I will probably delete.

I like playing this game. However, as the levels build up, it costs more to keep building. Makes sense. But offering the same cash reward, whether playing the first level or 100th level, doesn't make sense. You should offer higher reward amounts, the higher you go. I would play more if you did this. Now that I've gotten further in the game, I'm getting bored because it's taking so long to get the cash to build, so I just pop in once a day and play for a couple minutes but I would play more.

This is a neat game. If you want to play it, be prepared to spend the first 5 minutes x-ing out of pop ups, in-app ads/purchase options, reminders of the many mini games that run all at once. I'm not even joking it takes minutes before you ever roll the dice. That said, if you get past that annoyance, it is fun. Just not addictive and easy to play for a long time because of all the distractions and pop ups.

The game itself is fun, and addictive, and I've spent a little money playing it the last few weeks. However, I also just closed !!!18!!! pop up windows within 1 minute. Literally. I counted. 11 windows, rolled 23 dice, 7 more after that. This is extremely excessive, and honestly I will probably not keep playing too long because of that. I spend more time closing windows than playing the game.

Gameplay is so minimized by the thousand animations that come with every. single. move. I don't want to invite my friends. I don't need a waterfall of coins on the screen every time I make money. I don't need the story. Just let me play the stupid game. Barely played for 5 mins and over half was just animations. Would be reasonable if they were skippable but they are not. Also graphics are automatically set to "ultra" so it's an unskippable, unplayable battery drainer.

I have to say this is one of the most fun and fastest moving games I have tried out recently. Great graphics no glitches, and not an overabundance of ads. Only complaint is the 50 dice you get on refills doesn't last very long, buying dice is too expensive, so you have to play and come back over and again to make any progress. I'm still playing a month later, without buying any dice, so I awarded 5 stars.

I love this app! It's a very fun and involving game. You rebuild and build villages, battle, steal money from other villages, have different missions and trails to go on, attack villages and much more. It one of the best games I've placed in a long while. Download it today. Who knows I'll maybe be sneaking into your village to take your money soon. LoL. Don't wait, it's time to roll the dice!💯😊💜

Just started playing it, so far so good. I'm on the second kingdom now and I must say that it's a really cute game. It's easy to play, the characters are adorable and it's very entertaining. I haven't came across 1 ad yet, the graphics are great, no bugs or anything that needs to be fixed. It does have items in the store you can. I totally recommend this game! Maybe not to the real hard gamers but to people that just want to take a little enjoyable break from life this is the game for them.

I like the game. However, it could be much better. The free play is nice, but it runs out fairly quickly. You can't earn rolls unless you go below 70, then you only earn a few an hour, which gets you nowhere. If you run out, you can watch an ad to earn more, but that has a limit on it too, so then you're stuck. It makes it impossible to finish any of the extra events unless your willing to buy more rolls, and I can't justify that. I hope the game improves before I give it up.

The animations are cute and sound effects are fun. But every mechanic seems designed to get money. The odds are not equal, and over and over again the math don't math, like if I need to do Steal for a quest, suddenly I can roll hundreds of times without getting a steal. The pet is really being the last straw. I have managed to collect almost 1000 cookies in the last 3 days to get it to the next level, I need 5 cookies or it will reset. my only choice is to lose the progress or pay $4

So far seems good. I can see this being a spend money at the higher levels kind of game considering the lack of ads. Game mechanisms are very simple much like a slot machine. Fast paced, sounds, colorful display and quick easy wins. Good time waste if your maybe waiting for an appointment or you ride transit to get around and need something to do. You really don't have to pay attention to it to play.

Playing this game is more stressful than it is enjoyable. I can't even get into the game, without it crashing, can't get rewards without it crashing, can't build up kingdoms because it crashes. As I have seen many people have told you about this issue, and you know it's been happening for months, but you still won't fix anything. Makes no sense to me how you are still allowed to be on The Play Store or any app platform when you ignore what your consumer's are saying and never fixing anything.

This game is amazing! My favorite feature is the 5-7 ads you have to click out of after running out of rolls! Woooo! Make sure to put your rolls on the highest multiplier as well! This way, you waste all you're rolls and when it resets to lower multipliers, the game starts letting you win! Interesting! If you love being frustrated and wondering if you're being scammed, this is the game for you!!! Download now folks! 🤡🤡🤡

Kinda addictive, fun! Wish for more dice. Love the different landscapes. After playing, game seems to stop you just short of completing sets. Higher you go the more money you need. After playing for awhile, the sets are so outrageously high, you are on the same set for several days, you cannot accumulate enough money to advance without purchasing more and more dice. Seriously considering deleting game.😠

It takes too long to build levels without having to buy a bunch of stuff. The prices to build things get too expensive too quick. I thought this would be like monopoly go but it's not. You get like no chance to earn extra rolls to get money to build. Tried it for a week and don't like it. And way too many pop ups when you enter the game and when your out of rolls. It takes you 5 minutes to get through the pops to start the game.

I love the game, been playing it for some time now. HOWEVER, it lags A LOT and at first I thought it's from my phone but when I got a new one it remained the same and even worse. Also, the pop ups of the offers are insane, every time there aren't enough dice, they pop up. I think you have to look into that as well because they are annoying

I like this game, but after investing money into it I notice it kept crashing. I was on the bonus level on Meadow Trail and the game would completely stop multiple times. I lost all my progress playing this game and have to start over. I was just about to collect my reward but all progress lost. I'm very upset about it. I've tried to reach out to you and show my receipts. I've spent more than I've received and the game continues to crash. It's almost as if it's meant to just take our money.

Love the game but disappointed my friends have an option to receive double rolls on videos often and I haven't received it once. Also waking the peons each morning to receive more rolls or coins was taken away. It's so hard to get ahead anymore in this game. It's become harder to get shields, attack a kingdom and actually hit something, and to escape with all the loot before getting bombed. Now the last 2 days I can't even play the game. When I go on I can't click anything. Very frustrating.

The game is fun, i like the options of the roll multipliers and different little mini games. I strongly dislike having the pop ups of all the sales and specials and extra things every time the game starts AND when you run out of rolls. Just so many pop ups. Also my game is freezing up on the gift opening one (treasure hunting maybe). Can't even leave that area, have to close out the game. I'm missing out on a lot of coins and rolls because i can't open the presents.

This game is so irritating. I legit just opened the app and it took THREE MINUTES for the game to both load and go through all the pop-up ads and gameplay additions. Why it's so slow is beyond me. It fully loaded and I didn't even want to play it anymore. During the game play, it lags, every time a pop-up begins to load, the game will freeze for almost half a minute before the ad shows up, leaving anything you were doing hanging in the abyss of this games pop-up purgatory. Waited a few weeks and a couple dozen "kingdoms" before writing a review. I'm either playing for 20 seconds, 20 minutes, or 2 hours each time depending on how the dice rolls go and I never know which one it will be! Sometimes I keep winning and play (for free) for a long time and most of the other times I do my hourly free rolls and get nothing and spent the whole time closing all of the pop ups. Pretty fun overall though.

Are you kidding me here? This is why free apps suck so much. Take it down a notch on the ads. Turn on the game... spend money. New quest... spend money.. run out of dice... spend money. Let's say the game gives you 1 dice every time when you run out? After every single one is at least 3 pop ups with microtranactions. Come on now. Oh and I'm grouped with people that spend money? Good luck on trying to ever rank high. And what is the point of the bomb?

I highly enjoy this game overall! Normally I would give it five stars. However, the pop-up ads are driving me absolutely INSANE. It's not just once in a while, I'm getting 4, 5, 6 ads every time I run down my rolls, or come back to the main screen. I even made a purchase thinking maybe they'd slow down if I finally clicked it. No luck. I'd play way more, if not for spending a good chunk of my game time clicking out of the ads. It's time-consuming & aggravating to the point I just close the app.

Cute money grab game. I started in October, I play daily. I have yet to finish a single quest or finish updating single pet. Even though I spent some money, it is never enough. Game is rigged to never allow you to finish quests unless you keep spending. Due to this, I stopped buying anything, and now I just play for free. Gave up on the idea of finishing a quest or ever having a pet. All of you are just so money hungry, it's sad. And pop ups in the game are way over the top. They scream: pAAy!

It's fun, but please chill with the pop-ups. It's only been an hour since I last opened the app and there were still 9 pop ups when I opened it again, trying to get me to buy special deals. When I ran out of rolls, there were 8 more. For one of them you have to hit the X four times before it closes. It's ridiculous and does not make me want to buy anything. It makes me want to delete the game.

The game crashes 1 minute into playing (repeatedly). I have made sure the game is updated, I have a strong wifi connection, etc. When I win something the game crashes, when I reopen it my winnings are not there. Like today I won 450 rolls, the game crashed, I reopened the app & they weren't there. And one of the biggest things is I rarely spend money on games, but when I did I didn't get all of the things I paid money for.

At first, i didn't think I'd like this game much. Now I'm hooked .The only problem is I have to stop and wait until I get more rolls of the dice unless I want to purchase rolls to keep going. . Ok so its been weeks playing this game. love the graphics. All the little games within it , especially they change it up all the time! . No annoying ads! I wish the'd make the animals a little easier to get. Or how about a win an animal in a different challenge? This is my go to game! 5 stars!

It's a cute game. I play at much as I can for free. I think I paid $.99 once using some Google Play Rewards. My only complaint is the in-game popups. Every event has it's own pop-up. Every time you get close to running out of rolls or do run out of rolls you have to watch a pop up for everything going on.... All of which you have to spend real money on. But you have to click or if] So maybe the pop-ups should be limited to 2? Just a suggestion.

There is no game. This is a worse Monopoly Go. I can't stand the ugly little guy they have tried so hard to make into a "cute" mascot, but maybe this could be forgiven if there was any sort of game, but no. There are no decisions or thinking, just press button and money go up. There is an auto roll feature, but then this has stopping points when you have to manually press things like it matters when you hit a steal or attack.

My Royal puzzle is Frozen. I have cleared the 4th puzzle. It has not given me the gift ion covered nor my treasure box.
