This game is super adorable, fun, and easy to play! I Iove that it feels like a board game, and that all the actions are determined by rolling the dice! So it's low pressure and not overwhelming with things to do- it's relaxing. You use coins to rebuild each kingdom then move on to the next. I like that you can have fun without spending money- which means that I DO- to support the developers, because it feels like they care about more than just tricking you into countless micro transactions.

Very fun game,graphics are colorful. This is a well thought out game,lots of items to collect,the daily offers of free stuff are nice and it is not stingy with the items that we need. I have over 50 kingdoms restored...and have lots of fun protecting and restoring my kingdoms. The only ads are the pop up ones that are offers for freebies or anything we might need. They do not intrude on game play as they only come up when one is low on dice or at the opening of the game. Great job!!

I really like this addiction-triggering game, but when I lose 300 rolls just because I had to log out to run an errand? Pop-up ads galore, but that's what the money comes in, so I don't mind. The only thing you need to pay is the time you're exposed to ads. It's a really cute game and I don't usually fall for cutesy stuff, but when your Peons (pay-ons?) alert you on a small win that comes across as universal speak for "looka over here!", I'm sold!

It's a good game if it weren't for the ungodly amount of pop-ups. Once you log in, the sheer amount of clicking you have to do to just start is hilarious. Not to mention that every time you run out of dice, the same, what, six pop-ups appear every time. When you think it's done, it's not, and at this rate I feel like I'm collecting them like damn pokemon, I swear another gets added every day like the game took my begging as an invitation.

So, here's my review of Dice Dreams. But before we get to that, would you like to buy this dice pack for $5.99? No? Then how about this limited time deal for $2.99? Still no? Then here's some free stuff to entice you to buy something! Oh, and look here! More free stuff to get you to buy something! Please dont forget to rate us if you like this game! Now, how about participating in this limited time side quest? Overall, the game's "eh". Pop-ups are beyond annoyingly ridiculous before i can play

Love this game. I have one suggestion though. The piggy bank should reset after so many hours or days. Mine is up to $49.99 to buy my "saved" rolls. I can not afford to spend $50. If it reset or capped at $20 I'd be more willing to spend the money. Other than than that I am 100% addicted to the game and will continue to play regardless! Events and prizes are awesome and I love that there there is pretty much always an event happening.

Changing my review from 5 stars to 2. I don't enjoy playing as much as I used to b/c of recent changes in the game. Now instead of earning cookies for your pet, you just get spins to collect them that don't give you anywhere near as many; so it takes forever to level up in feeding your pet. That was hard enough to do before; it's almost impossible now. Also the Trails are now impossible to complete, especially the ones with the bully. No matter what you throw at him, it doesn't make a dent.

This game is stingy, greedy, and glitchy. The game is rigged trying to manipulate you into buying their packages in order for you to advance or finish challenges. Yet others have complained that even purchasing packages don't help you to complete challenges. The further you advance the more difficult it is to finish levels fast. For Dice Dreams to bombard you with pop-ups to buy their "deals", the game constantly crashes, glitches, or doesn't reward you. Too many bugs & technical issues.

I'm very much enjoying this game. It's the perfect casual game for me. I'm currently on the 20th world and still going strong. There are various ways to win coins and more dice rolls without spending money. There is no pay wall in order to advance, which is wonderful. Also scratching that slight gambling itch without repercussions is superb to me. There are ads of course, but with all the heart and care the developers have poured into it; I don't mind the advertisements. All in all a great game.

The game is mildly entertaining and not a bad way to pass some time. It is nice to play a game without tons of ads, though the offers are slightly annoying and overpriced for what the game is. There really is no goal or skill to the game and the team aspect or rival aspect of the game is slightly useless. It's mostly just short-term time wasting and luck. Not worth spending any real money for in game stuff when there's no goal to the game to get ahead.

You know, I love this kind of game. I find it fulfilling. However! I was recently playing a tournament, kept my eyes on the tournament through the final minutes and was in first place. At the end, it popped up to give me my rewards and NOTHING happened. No 2000 rolls. No coins. No guaranteed missing sticker. NOTHING! And for anyone that plays the game knows, rolls are ridiculously expensive. Especially when you are multiplying them to achieve bigger rewards. So disappointing!

I really enjoy this game, good amount of grindy, smooth animations, really cute themed boards. But my god, the pop ups when you run out of moves are SO bad. Run out? 4 pop-ups to buy some more. Watch an ad to get free moves, use those, then four pop ups again! It's ridiculous. Tone those down to once per time the game is open and it'd be perfect.

Fun game, too many pop-ups! It's annoying how many pop-ups appear when you just opening the game. Instead of having all these pop ups so you're forced to go through them all maybe you should just have indicators on the actual event/offer/etc so the user has the option to click on it at their convenience. Because of this, I will be uninstall in this game. Otherwise, I really did enjoy playing it.

it's annoying having pop ups to buy stuff every time I get a reward. Or move to a next stage,the game is fun but y'all seem to be trying to push sales and overtime the game because nothing more then tapping x 50 times. I see them on the side I don't need to be reminded all the time. Other then that game is fun. I understand but it's a bit excessive and takes the joy out of it I made sure my throws were matched. Maybe a pop up would you like to prolong play check these offers out. ->
Fun game but the constant pop ups asking you to purchase packs, invite friends, etc make you lose coins as by time you have closed them all others steal the coins which I'd annoying.

I had amassed almost 400,000 coins and since I was having fun I agreed to invite a friend using the popup offer in game. When I came back minutes later, 375,000 coins were stolen. This is the third time I've left the game only to be penalized for doing so. Oh well, now I know to build before I leave the game. Also, if I change to another tab (such as to check an email), when I switch back, the game reloads as if I had closed it entirely.

Im a person that pays attention to details. When you go to steal with the dice. If you roll a number 6,5,4 twice in a row the 3rd roll will be a automatic bomb. Next it cost 10 millions to build a place right. Even rolling the dice at x25 you still don't make enough to add up to the amount that it cost to build. The constant ads popping up trying to get you to purchase things is ridiculous. Not a fan, but I do like the game. As to why I gave it two stars.

Issues with In-App purchases to where it'll deduct the amount but not award me what I bought. I've had to dispute two transactions with my bank because of this and their support never gets back to you. Be wary. It's annoying, especially for a game that is very much pay to play. It also seems the more we spend the more expensive the packs get. I'm not a fan of that as I shouldn't always get offers for packs that are $25 or more.

I was addicted to this game until it began constantly having issues. Every time the events change, i am missing something, usually a mini-game. I'll receive the items for the mini-game (such as puzzle pieces or spatulas), but the mini-game itself is nowhere to be found. It's kinda strange and very disappointing 😞

Fun game and addictive. . . but. . . as everyone has said, being spammed with the same ads everytime I log in and log off is super annoying. The option to watch ads to get extra rolls is a nice feature, it even works for my wife but when I watch an ad - I am just watching an ad. I get no spins afterwards. As well, some of the mini games they run are absolutely ridiculous. I get spins to go 250 spaces and I don't even see the cursor move toward the next chest to open. It's pay to play. . .

Fun to play, BUT prepare to be frustrated by game errors and glitches. They are worse every time the makers issue a new update. I really like the pet challenges. However, since the first one, it is not possible to finish all 10 levels without in-game purchasing. Some days you aren't able to earn cookies at all. The cookie wheel is great, when it works.

Nice game, WAY too many popups... Seriously considering installing the game. Game is fun, but the constant barrage of pop-up, pop-up, wait, pop-up, pop-up gets VERY annoying trying to get you to buy in game stuff. Would be 1 start for the annoyance, but I have it two because it is well done and fun to play until the popups start. Update: uninstalling... Popups are getting worse .. spend half of my play time just waiting to click the x to close them...

It keeps freezing up. When it does, I lose the rolls I had gotten for attacking or whatever I had earned. If you love to "X" out of 5+ sales offers for purchasing additional coins, then this app is for you. Yes, it is "free to play" but the constant popups to purchase is too much. To top it off, they don't actually address your situation when you send a message, they just copy and paste a relevant subject from the help section.

It's cute and fun and changes enough to stay interesting, but sometimes too quickly to accomplish much. Having friends playing is helpful sometimes. There are different activities and events to keep it from becoming monotonous. Many of the events can not be completed without a large number of rolls, though. The pets are cute but impossible to acquire without spending your own money for extra food

Horrible! The game freezes and closes every time I hit a large jackpot, win a steal or try to view a video to get free dice throws. I also purchased items in the game but because it froze AFTER the purchase processed, the items I purchased never made it into the game. I made it to Kingdom 8 and cannot even update the game. No reply from the creator on that problem either. I'll be deleting this app and would not recommend spending money on it until those issues are fixed.

This game is fun to play but after the first kingdom, when you run out of rolls and coins, you're pretty much destroyed unless you have a couple of friends on Facebook you can invite to get a free gift. If not, you do have a set time to wait for some free rolls or coins. Afte you get the hang of it though the coins and the rolls come in easier and faster. The graphics are nice, bright, and clean. Overall, a very enjoyable little game.

This is such a fun game. Plus the customer service is some of the best that I've ever had. When I a problem with the game, they didn't stop working on it until it was fixed. They were very nice about everything I needed help with.

I don't see the purpose in this game. You roll the dice to get coins to complete kingdoms, that's it. There is no skill or tactics, just pure luck and not even that because the game is designed to make you lose so that you could spend money. The reason I gave it any stars is because it is well developed and has cute characters and a good advert. Other than that, there is nothing that will get me to keep playing. To top it off, there's constant nagging popups inviting you to buy packs and coins.

So fun so far . Absolutely love the design and graphics . Updated review 4 months later . You can not get any where in this game! After you pass certain levels you are just stuck unless you pay to play . There's not enough rewards . Not enough dice rolls . There's nothing fast about it . It runs slow . Glitches & freezes . I've been on the same level for over a month! You can never get enough rolls to get progress . Unless you are paying! You get 50 reward rolls a day & 50 don't do anything

The game started out as fun, but as time went on the developers placed more and more restrictions on accumulating rolls through both game play and watching advertisements (you cannot even have the option of watching ads if you have 3000 rolls). It may come as a surprise to foreign debelopers, but Americans are not keen about having things they've grown accustomed to taken away. Additionally, the game has become exceedingly repetitive. Once I've exhausted my accumulated rolls, I'll delete it.

Could be a great game if 1. You can at least regenerate spins a bit faster. Waiting forever to be able to play for 3 mins isn't fun. 2. The game wasn't so friggin obnoxious with the amount of pop ups of content for sale. 3. Someone can explain to me how a second after a new event starts there's already people with thousands on the score board? Developers way to get people to spend to be able to beat that? Who knows. Anyhoo, could be a great game ....

Also, I'm pretty high up in the game, and I have no issue spending money, but the prices are just ridiculous now.

This game is very heavily advertised on Mistplay events. Surprisingly, it is very enjoyable, and I can play for pretty much any length of time (as long as I have rolls available). My only critique is how very in your face the game is about trying to get you to spend money. On that note though, at least this game has no forced ads to watch, only optional ones to get more rolls.

Too many pop-ups! The in-game ads for real-money purchases is extreme. To startup, there are a dozen. Every time you reach 0 rolls, there are 5 (of the same ads) again. Game play itself, when you get to it, is standard. The game gives you lots of free rolls, keeps you playing; if you have the patience to tap away all the pop-ups.

Started out great! But then I had an issue with one of the games, Royal Puzzle. I completed the 2nd Puzzle and it wouldn't advance to the next Puzzle or allow me to claim reward. Overall fun game but the pop-ups, for in-app purchases, after you run out of rolls for dice make it hard to play. I only give it 4 stars, for the pop-ups for purchases, after every single time that you run out of dice in a day, and would be nice to see more dice refreshes in a day, so I could play more :)

I Love the game but 80% of the time it doesn't want to load. I can't always play when I want too. The only other thing I wish the game had, is a way to earn more coins immediately or spins like with dice games inside the main game. When you run out of coins you just have to stop playing. Other than that I absolutely love this game. I love the little creatures, I love that we get to fling them across the landscape in a sling shot!!! Their expressions are hilarious. It's the only game I play.

I enjoy this game tremendously. It's a free app so, ads come with the territory. However.....the amount of times I've had to uninstall/reinstall this game is RIDICULOUS! Recently I've lost 1000+ rolls b/c of this! Not to mention the millions of coins and hundreds of rolls I've lost in the past! I'd be SUPER UPSET if I'd spent money on it & with their track record, I'd recommend playing for generic fun and not putting cash into it.

Addicting and Lots of Fun. I stumbled upon this game from another app. There are only ads if you want a few extra dice, and a couple of click-through screens as you run out of roles. You can certainly spend cash in the game, but it's still certainly playable without doing so. There are lots of opportunities to earn roles and coins throughout the day. Update: Like others I have unfortunately had the experience of not receiving awards after winning a tournament. I filled out a form & heard nothing

This a great game if you're the type of person who loves waiting a full 2 or 3 minutes to actually play after opening the app! The constant barrage of unskippable animations really makes this a top-notch slog. Then, if that's not enough for you, when you run out of rolls, you get about 400 pop-ups wanting you to spend actual money on packs. Incredible. Its full of things that don't really make sense, and charging people to open their piggy bank is a really nice cash grab. Good Luck.

I know apps and games have their issues as far as technical issues. But I'm finding myself having more issues with this game. As much as I love it and spend a lot of money playing it. I feel sometimes that this game loves to rip you off on the prizes that you win. I just One a treasure hunt that allowed me to use my coins to finish the map. But I was unable to claim my prize because it somehow could not connect. So when the game restarted is as if I never won. That's why I give it 1 star.

Very addictive, ad heavy.. There are a number of facets to the game and it can be played without making purchases. For every game you play for free, expect at least a couple of ads. This one tends to have four or five ads and offers everytime you exhaust your roles. Definitely a must play. 2022-06-28 Update And now my account is locked for no apparent reason.

Hi everyone, I have enjoyed playing Dice Dreams. It's very exciting with the multiple challenges that seemed to be going on at the same time. And I don't mind spending a little extra to get some extra dice are cookies to feed my fox. But when I first started playing it was $3.99 for a lot of extras and then a couple dollars more for the next plan. Then you slowly pushed it up to $5.99 to $7.99. To a couple free things and WOW 14.99! OR You just start at $20 an more! What's up with that !! ☹

UPDATE: Changed my review to 5 stars. They fixed it and gave me the dice I lost plus 100 extra. (Although less pop ups would be nice) I really do like this game, but I spent money to break the piggy bank to get 1.5k rolls, I hadn't used any of them at all, and when I went back into the game they were all gone, reset back down to zero. I sent in a help ticket and I'm still waiting for a response, but posting here too, if anyone plans on buying that, be wary.

Just another lottery style game trying to get you to spend money. Way too many adds pop up for "deals" everytime you log in. It can be upwards of five and some of them have animation and you can't close until the animation is finished. It's incredibly obnoxious. There are always WAY too many side hustles going on, like collecting cards to earn more dice/coins. And that's just one of several. The dice are also very very clearly not random.

Packs are a rip off and don't always deliver what they show. Support are not helpful. I spent my own my on the game and was not given what was advertised. As I thought support would help out I continued with the game, to be told this would not be the case. Stupidly I paid again, and again I was short changed, doubly this time, half of the item was missing. Also when you add friends 90% of the time you have to attack your friends rather than strangers, which you often have no choice over!

UPDATE: Ads & pop-up "offers" are getting worse. I've counted as many as 10 pop-ups just to start playing or when you run out if dice. Spend as much time (or more) watching offers as playing. SERIOUSLY CONSIDERING UNINSTALLING. Developer needs to cut down on how often offers are displayed. It is ruining gameplay. Will increase rating when ads and game are balanced. Cute game, easy to play. It is possible to play without buying rolls, but you'll have to wait a bit between sessions if you do.

This is a Super fun and addicting game but Beware beware beware, this game is set up to make you fail on quests. Hense the 1 star review. I was on my last stage of the Pet quest, So I figured I'd hurry things along and make in game purchases. I tried several times and kept getting denied. So again Beware. They come out with some great ideas for the game but leave you disappointed in the end. When the quests are not achievable. I may even consider uninstalling after this.

love the game but there's a couple things that get annoying. First you have to click out of 4-6 pop ups when you first start the game and 4-6 pop ups every time you use up all your dice. It's excessive and annoying. The pets are adorable, HOWEVER you can only keep them IF you spend real money on the game The pets should be much easier to keep, and most people don't have the deep pockets to keep them.

Totally awesome game with really fun animation. Challenges and tournaments make for amazing game playing. Best of all we don't have to pay to play. I've come in first in several tournaments and haven't spent any money on the game. Just wish they'd bring back the rewarded videos to get extra rolls. Still playing for free, still a really fun game. Just need more opportunities to get rolls, like bringing back the rewarded videos. Still loving this game!

I played a dice game before this one. Utterly loved it. The game was fun, and I didn't feel like it was punishing me or trying to force me to spend money. This game tries to take your money and screws you over. On multiple occasions, I have gotten a 20%off on build costs. I tried to spend through my dice rolls. When your roll is over the amount available, they hit you with game ads. Like 5 to 7. When I had the 20% off, the first thing it did, both times, was to force it down to 15%.
I completed the cake craze album and didnt get my 1,500 rolls 😬 the app has been glitching and freezing up really bad for days now. Ive uninstalled and installed again, same thing.

Cute game, love that it is fast paced. But the popups that happen EVERY SINGLE TIME you are out of rolls is the most annoying thing ever. With it being so fast paced, you can run out of rolls in seconds, get more and run out again. So forcing those popups to 'buy' stuff every time is ridiculous. Just make it so it's once upon loading the game and then stooooooop.

Overall an easy play. Similar to other games I've tried but has cute aspects. They seem to have gotten rid of card trading, which is nice, duplicates now just go towards a chest. The one thing I find annoying is that whenever you run out of dice you'll get between 5-10 popups with offers, etc. And you generally run out of dice 2 to 3 times per login.

In the beginning, this game was a lot of fun. One could play it even without spending lot's of money. I did buy some DicePacks though in the past. However, recently the game turned into a pay for play game. It is impossible to get stickers. Recently I spend enough money to buy 300 Dream Packs. Out of these Dream Packs, keep in mind these are 2400 stickers, there were only two new stickers. All the other stickers are just stickers I already have. The game algorithm turned into a scam.

Fun easy game overall. These last few hours, I've accumulated a lot of potions for the treasure hunt. Unfortunately, when I open the treasure hunt, then it won't open any gifts or respond anywhere I push. You nay gear tge arrow back click or tge question mark click. But nothing happens. Overall fun and addicting game. Need to be able to cash in cards for money or dice tho, I literally have 25 of the same cards guys come on. The one thing I'm super frustrated with is how many times the in-app purchases pop up. Whenever you run out of dice or open the app, you have to exit out of 5 different in-app purchases. I GET IT, YOU WANT ME TO SPEND MONEY! You literally see the little circles on the main screen while you're playing anyways. STOP DOING THIS FOR THE LOVE OF GOD!

The animations are super cute and entertaining! Like with any game there's a push for in game purchases. This wouldn't be so bad if they didn't pop up everytime I roll the dice; that's the only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5. Despite the push there are plenty of free ways to earn coins, power ups, rolls, etc so long as you don't mind waiting. That's what I love. There is no major hindrance/experience in game play for lack of purchases. It combines so many different elements!

Would like to see more free rolls and variety in the dice. You hardly land on anything but attack, steal, coins, and shields. The other items don't roll up, long waiting time for full amount of rolls, expensive to buy dice for such a quick play, and you can't even hold the button for a roll it automatically throws. Think it would be more fun if these things would change and make you feel like you at least get to shake the dice a little before throwing.

Update!!! After contacting them, they were very understanding and went above what was the issue and made it right and then some. Since then, there have been no issues. I spend money on games & I'm not saying that to brag, bc it's nothing to brag about. I say that just to say, though I don't mind spending money on games, especially if they're entertaining & I feel as if I'm getting a somewhat decent deal - nothing special, just decent - to make any progress in this game it will become very expensive & the amount you spend compared to the return you get, is horrible to say the least. If you want to spend lots for minimal value/entertainment, this is your game.

there are some fun parts of the game. but, it preys on the fear of missing out. there are a lot of timers on events. and keeping a pet is double timed. you get so many days to level up the pet to 10, but you have limited time to keep each level. and the final level definitely requires money to keep the pet in the end. there isn't a single event you can finish completely without real world money. fun enough, just don't expect to finish any events without money.

Fun Game, but it's very "pay to play" after a while, or else it's super slow going. If you can spend the 2 to 5 bucks now and then it's good. but that's most games now a days The only actual complaint is that when your rolling the dice and it gets low or you stop at 0, the game will bombard you with "deals" or "sales" to get more rolls.

Game is fun to play. I enjoy everytime I play. But for the last week I've been trying to log in and it keeps kicking me out. I've tried restarting so many times still nothing. I've tried everything I looked up to see maybe there was a problem with my phone or just the game. Well nope it's the game. If I don't get to log in soon I'll be deleting the game. If you enjoy pop ups you're going to love this game! One day I quit counting after I got up to 25 popups just opening the game. It is cute and people get addicted to it. They just need to get rid of f the constant popups.

Update 3/3/25.. I made a purchase and I haven't gotten my purchase while they charged my account. And the event ends in 12 hrs This game start off as fun. The game is fun, but the pop-ups trying to sell specials are obnoxious. Start the game, 5+ pop-ups. Low on dice, 5+ pop-ups. Out of dice, 5+ pop-ups. I am currently only playing to earn in-game currency for another game, and will be uninstalling the moment that's done.

I enjoy this game but the pop-ups are overwhelming. Everytime I click on anything there's 5 pop-ups asking me to buy something. Its very frustrating. And I have spent money on this game but everytime it feels like what I purchase gets me no where. I just purchased more rolls and only got to play 15 more min before running out. The game essentially gives you 5 minutes of game time for free at most per day.

Fun game Watch your cubes, they can go fast. I like the peons when they give gifts. Very entertaining. Update July 18th, game freezes alot. Still fun but good grief, with all the pop ups, takes several minutes before I can actually play. That needs to change. This is a fun dice game. Just some things. It's constantly flashing 3 to 4 offers in your face multiple times during play to get you to buy more rolls. Your friends can't help you in the game. All they do is attack and steal from you. If you want to trade with them you have to go to a separate Facebook group and join that, where you're targeted by scammers. It would be much simpler and safer if you could request trades within the game. Sometimes the game glitches and you can lose your power up.

Piece of advice, shoving 100000 ads in my face everytime I open the app, run out of the right amount of dice, or run out of dice completely, will NOT encourage me to buy any of your offers. Infact, it pushes me to NOT buy anything. Just thought I'd let you know. I'd rate it 5 stars but this is definitely a pay to win game. You will NOT get a pet unless you spend money. The higher the lvl, the less you receive in rolling the dice. So you'll be on a lvl for awhile, unless you spend money.

Update, I'm still playing the game even though irritated with the amount of time it takes to go through the offers.. I in no way shape or form will spend real world dollars until it is easier to get into the game and takes less time. Great time waster and a lot of fun, update.. game keeps getting better, too many "Offers".. Update.. game is still tons of fun, again it's way too many offers they take too much time to go through.. other than that I totally recommend this game.

I constantly find myself asking "why am I still bothering to play this game?" I just counted and there are SEVEN different sales that pop up that you have to exit out of just to be able to get to the game. If you ever run out of dice, be prepared to click through those SEVEN different sales screens. EVERY. TIME. I get it. These criminals want to make money and cash out. But could you be anymore obvious? I only play because it's attached to Mistplay. Otherwise I wouldn't bother!

It's boring, it's not a challenge, and it's laggy. It takes a long time to be able to get daily dice rolls, so you end up stuck not being able to do anything, making it really slow to update your kingdom. When you do have dice, there are SO many ads trying to get you to spend money on the game. Do not appreciate closing out of 6 ads when I'm done rolling dice. The "challenges" (sneak, attack, steal, etc) are extremely boring, you're guaranteed coins no matter what. Utter waste of time.

I only downloaded this to see if I could win some cash, and the ads suggest everyone else on here is pretty much here for the same reasons. The pop-up offers to spend money, in that context, are hella annoying. It's every damn time you open the app, or run out of rolls. Every. Time. Like obviously I'm not wanting to spend money, man, duh?!?! Pls stop asking. If I don't see the promised payouts soon, I'm probably just gonna uninstall. It's not THAT fun, otherwise.

The game is a fun little idle game. The graphics are cute. I actually really enjoy the game. However, it only gets 3 stars because of in game sales pop-ups. This game is a trap. Its fun until you're playing for a while, the higher level you are the more ridiculous it is to play. Graphics are incredible. You can play comfortably, win, and advance in the game without spending money which is both enjoyable and relaxing. The mini games are awesome because they allow you to at least win at something. No ads. Allows you to join a team to maximize rewards in addition to leaderboards. It's the most fun and relaxing game I've played in a while and I don't feel like I'm being preyed upon for money or through ads. 10/10 recommend. It's addicting for sure.

money hungry! the concept is fun imo (strategy) but the odds are forever not in your favor. you spend coins to play, you spend more to extend your game so you can beat the level, and you don't get many to use. then they beg u to spend real money. unless you log in every hour to grab coins, you'll never have enough to actually enjoy the game very long. on a positive note, I do like the concept, and I like the animation.

Dice Dreams is a fun and addictive dice-rolling game where players attack kingdoms, collect coins, and compete with friends. It features vibrant graphics, engaging gameplay, and frequent events. However, progress depends heavily on luck, and dice rolls run out quickly, often pushing in-app purchases or ads. If you enjoy casual games like Coin Master, this is a great pick, but be prepared for some pay-to-win elements.

You spend money in game and dont recieve what you purchased along with other rewards that you've earned. I hate the fact it closes randomly... And also the fact I purchased the same package twice and never received my items, cause the game either froze or closed... But it took my money both times... Pay to play game. It can be a fun game but it's not worth playing unless you want to waste actual money to be able to progress. The higher level you get to, the more impossible the tasks are to finish in their time frame without spending money, it becomes painfully obvious this game is nothing short of a money grab... not to mention all of the pop ups... it was fun but it's quickly losing its playability as you only get a small amount of rolls to complete a large amount of things... The game is amazing, but you guys are lowkey trash. Making all the stuff so expensive. I'm an avid player of phone games so I was disappointed to find that your 5$ piggy bank has a limit of 300. Game play and events all force you to spend money. I don't mind spending a few dollars here and there to enjoy a game and support devs, but this game punishes you for it. I enjoy playing the game very much. However, this is the second time I have purchased items and not received the free incentives. Just really learing game. There are a few glitches, there have been several times where I have claimed a reward and not received it. Levels are sometimes near impossible to reach. Should not have to purchase as often in my opinion if you want to keep players playing. I do like that there are multiple thing going on at all times. Very interactive, keeps your attention.

So so sooooo many pop ups constantly wanting you to spend money. You will have to spend money if you want dice to roll. It's pretty ridiculous how much you have to spend to get much playtime. Do you like closing pop-ups? Do you like meaningless progression systems? Do you like all game mechanics to be rigged? I'm not normally a big fan of games but DiceDreams has hooked me! I play everyday cause it's alot of fun. I like that it has a variety of stuff to do and not just rolling the dice. Expect the first five minutes to be nothing but pop-ups. Also, it will bog down your phone and you never know if it is loading the next money grab or if you can finally pay. I see no reason to give this app my money or time. If you wager five rolls and have less than five - you get three to five pop-ups. Spend the last >5 rolls and you will then get another set of pop-ups.

I used to love this game a lot more. Recently noticed that the rolls do not always reward you the rewards consistently. I play daily and have watch it not account for the prizes I win. It's frustrating as a consistent player. Won a few of the side tournaments and when I was supposed to receive the prize, no rolls, coins or anything. Also wish there was an option to not show package purchases over and over. It's annoying and doesn't prompt me to buy them.

It's a fun way to kill time when u have to sit and wait. Your dice build back up semi quickly, but they give you free dice to claim almost daily. You earn extra dice in all the little side games. I can play for hours and have never put money into the game. They did a great job on this game. There's always something new on it. And it's a generous game. Try it out I'm sure u will love it.

it's a pretty fun game. you roll 3 dice with different symbols. you "battle" different Facebook people. friends and not. as you collect coins you "build" different statues in different cities, countries, and fantasy places. it's pretty time consuming. I have spent maybe 5 dollars. it gave me quite a bit in 2 events. they do reset quickly for a game. it's not pay to win and I live a commanding life so it's nice to relax and be able to play for maybe 60 minutes a day. customer support is very good

This game is fun but I do notice that there are many events going on at once in the game and it sometimes takes a bit to do something in the game when something doesn't pop up you think you can roll the dice but no you need to wait for an even to pop up. Other than that, I like collecting many of the free items. Something I wish the game had is if the groups said if they are private before clicking and keep having to find a group that isn't set to private or full.

Love this game! Highly addictive. Great graphics, cute characters, and revenge... Edit: the game is fun.. But I'm over having to X out 4-7 pop ups even I run out of rolls.. Every time I change my bet when I run out. Yes..I KNOW I'm out of rolls..I don't need to see your deals for more every time, especially when they are all there in the main play screen any time someone wants to click on them. Deleting. Won't be back

The game is a lot of fun but there's so many glitches! It freezes up, it'll kick me out, a lot of times it doesn't want to open until I clear all apps that I had opened beforehand then it'll still take 3 or more tries to get it open to play. And a lot of pay to play ads. But once I get past all that I really enjoy the game. Fix all the glitches and I'll give you that 5th star ⭐⭐

I fell in love with dice dreams the very first time I played and I play several times a day...I can't get enuf of it! And I've found quite a few new friend in the game as well as a few friends that accepted my invited! I'll keep playing dice dreams as long as it's still available to play! Bring on the competitions they are awesome challenges to the game!👍🥰😁

Fun but takes your money! you spend your money than it ups it more so you are rolling the same amount as the free spins.Plus when you buy a pack for 5.99 or more and it has free packs underneath, it closes out the game and you NEVER GET the extra rewards. even ones I have bought over 15.99 more than 10 TIMES. didn't lean my lesson. Do not spend your money.

I enjoy the game but my first purchase wasn't given to me. I contacted support and they said be patient but haven't heard anything in 5 days. It's just a couple dollars but it shows the game is dangerous with taking your money and not giving you rewards. I also see, after going back, that I'm not the only one with this issue. I just want my purchase!!

This is a great game and I have something important to say regarding a bug that I encountered today. I'm relatively new to the game, and just unlocked albums; this is where the bug started. The game will make you watch a video about albums once you unlock them, you cannot do anything about it. it will not play if the device volume is not on or muted. I had my device volume up, but I had previously muted all the in game sound. So the video would not play, and I could no longer play the game.

I used to love this game but lately everytime I go to the treasure part of the game, it freezes and I have to quit the app and it keeps doing it. There's no point in playing in gaining points if I can't use them before this gone because it keeps freezing. Also there's been way too many times where I've been to the same kingdom. It's not fun playing when you keep going to the same kingdom you played in the past

It's definitely a fun little gambling game. It doesn't have invasive ads that take up your whole screen that makes it impossible to play the game for 30 seconds. What this app doesn't have in ads, it makes up for in Micro-transactions, which is definitely why this app is ad-free. They're all relatively small but It's the only thing I dislike about the game. It heavily shoves its micro-transactions at you when you run out of dice to roll. Otherwise, it's pretty fun.

Entertaining and fun, stealing from other players, blowing up their Kingdoms, getting revenge, each level has different boards and you collect different things along the way to build your kingdoms, each building costs so much money but others can come in and destroy so beware! The graphics are spot on! I just wish when we got free spins things would double or something, nothing cool happens but the board change and a disco ball drops!!!

After this past update, the amount of rolls received after watching an ad went from between 10 & 20 to 2!?! Not cool and not worth watching an ad for. It also began to get very glitchy right before the update, I won enough to update my pet at the final stage but wasn't given any of my rewards that I had won...wasn't going to comment about it but now feel the need to. Prior to all of this, I play the game daily and would have given it 5 stars. Now I'm just not sure I will continue to play this...

I love this game! I look forward to opening my app up to see how many rolls I have replenished. I just wish they would replenish more often. I do not buy additional rolls/stickers to keep playing though. Reminds my of slots at a casino, without having to spend real money. It is a leisure game to play and it's fun! Cool little bonuses if you roll certain icons and you get to restore different kingdoms. Highly recommend! Even my young daughter can play it!

Fun to play alone or with friends. I'm getting a bit frustrated with all the pop ups. I don't mind if you do them once but 5 pop ups before you can start, then 5 pop ups when you are out of dice, and if you play mini games more pop ups. I'm just don't sure it worth playing the game if I always have to wait for the pop ups to be done. Why can't we see our friends on the map?

This game is fun, yet it has many flaws. First off, I have spent a lot of money on this game, and twice I have lost rank within the game and have been attacked and not able to properly play due to me not being able to press the buttons and have them work, as someone else has stated in their review. This isn't fair. Secondly, sometimes when you get shields, they don't convert to dice if your shields are full like they are supposed to. So very disappointing....

Colorful, competitive game that at times is so frustrating. I gave 5 stars for graphics and let's face it a pretty good game. All in all 5 stars! Update- The game continues to be everything and more. Still love it! Just made level 51 and boy does it get challenging the higher you go. Thank goodness for ads when I'm just a few pennies short on a build. Can get me a moment more to go.

I like the game but something that prevents me from enjoying it fully is the huge amount of offers.....Once you open the game you are being harassed with offers, passes, tournaments and what not , visually covering the whole screen: "Buy this", "Buy that" "New offer", "Ultimaate offer" with animations that take forever to close or skip. No matter what you do there is a 100% chance that you will get an offer shoved in your face in any second

It's a fun game if you have the money to put into it to keep going, if you don't the down time while waiting for dice to build up is extremely long and almost not worth playing, from my experience after going thru $40 in 5 days I had to quit putting money and play regular and I check in twice a day and am able to play about a hour each time if that. They have contest but I learned if you don't buy dice you don't play enough to win much from them. Over all im contemplating quitting the game.

Standard dice game, buildings and coins and challenges that are heavily stacked towards purchasing. But those purchases don't buy any play time at all. A strategic infusion of money in one of my games has bought me energy I will feed on for a week, maybe two. The same valued cash infusion into Dice Dreams lasted less than five minutes. This game is mostly closing pop ups for purchase options. I advise spending elsewhere. There are other dice games that feel much more rewarding.

Game is meh. No skill needed. Just continuous play of the same 3 or 4 mini games. They take a part of your winnings and hold them to make you pay. For me personally I will never pay for a phone game period. The pop ups after you run out of dice are so pointless and annoying. As like many others, you are just a cash grab game. End of story. Play if you like repetitive and boring games or if you have money to give away.

Fun, exciting, you can purchase, but don't have to, rolls regegenerate and you can win free rolls. Steal, attack and fight other players for coins to build your levels. I enjoy this game, but lately, trying to get enough cookies to advance your pet is ridiculously slow, small rewards, and then you almost get it leveled and lose all your advancement.

I love this game and would have given 5 stars. However, the constant pop-up windows to buy things, especially while I still have dice rolls and $$, have gotten to be a bit overwhelming and ruins the game. I counted 9 pop-up windows today. That is just too much. Sometimes it's 5, other times 7 pop-ups. Please, you have a good relaxing and fun game here. There is no need to bombard players with these pop-ups. I even made a purchase before all of this pop-up nonsense started.

Dice, dice, and more dice. If you like board games and rolling the dice, then Dice Dreams is just the game for you. You get little kingdoms to restore and you restore them by using dice rolls. You also get to attack, steal, defend, and more. There's something for everyone! From Treasure Hunts to Rock, Paper, Scissors - whatever you like, you're likely to find in this game! Pros: DICE ROLLS!!! Cons: Sometimes the pop-ups get a little overwhelming.

I've now had the second time where a massive glitch in the game happen and customer service has done nothing. Yesterday, I reached out about a glitch with the trail, it was no longer opening, and I couldn't use the hundreds of tokens I had saved up before the timer ended. No response from customer service. Now the trail is over, and I lost out of everything left in the trail.

Loads of fun, a stress reliever, and visually adorable!! I play before work, on lunch breaks, and as a nightcap. The once rare game freezes weren't a problem until nothing worked except un-installing the game completely, which was "stressful." Hopefully, that was a one-time thing and this awesome hand will continue to live up to its hype!

Absolutely fun game to pass the time. Only complaint is they shove their sales down your throat. If you are about to run out of dice 5 to 6 different sales popup individually after each sale you x out and then when you run out of dice it does it again and this is NOT just once but EVERY time you play. Gets annoying to the point that I wont roll when my dice are less than 10.

Fun. Barely any ads. Pushes micro transactions heavily, but it really isn't that bad since the ads are not there at all. As i did enjoy this game at 1st, I jave sunk a few dollars into it and the probability for this game is horrible. It's very predatory after it knows you've spent some money. Your probability goes down for good spins and rolls. How do I get the same exact low number after 15 spins?? The exact number on the wheel! I'm done w this game. Had it been fair I would keep playing.

The style of the game is cute but the top up popups every time you run out of dice is WAY too much. I counted over 5 yesterday and I just ended up closing the app. It's aggressive to the point where even if I was inclined to spend money on these types of games, I wouldn't. It's too much when we can already see all of the bundles crowding the game screen.

Lots of glitches that end up costing you in the long run. Game freezes constantly. I won a prize but there was a glitch and I did not get the winnings. I contacted customer support. They gave Me a fraction of what I would have gotten from the prize. Just today had the same thing happen again. Let's see how they handle this issue. Getting real close to just giving up and finding a new game to play.

I've been playing dice dreams for months and suddenly I can't get in any longer. Tells me to tap for a video and then freezes up. It's been that way for a couple of weeks now. I'm really disappointed it's one of the few games I've enjoyed for quite some time. Would love to know how to get back in. I've uninstalled, reinstalled, updated... done everything I can possibly think of

Super addictive. Kudos. Having what seems to be having some technical difficulties, possibly internet connection issue, the further I get into the game. The "side missions" for lack of a better term, make the game. I do like the guest account option. I like how the little guys laugh at you when your steal blows up. Makes you feel a little bit less unhappy that it randomly blew up in your face. Lol.

This chance based game has an addicting gameplay loop, which is unfortunate because said gameplay loops is also extremely boring, repetitive and understimulating. I do like the art style of the game, but it's so limited, the characters all look the same and there is no customization at all. The sound design is cute at first but quickly becomes repetitive and obnoxious. The most annoying thing about this game is the constant pop-ups everyday for you to spend money that take forever to close. 2/5

I would have easily given a 5 star rating, however since the last update it no longer gives you the opportunity to watch videos for free dice when you are out and some people can't always afford to buy extra dice. I have purchased quite a few but sometimes can't. I have been playing this game for years and love it aside of this one issue. So with that being said if the creator would bring back the videos to watch for free dice I would absolutely give a 5 star. 😊

Super addicting and fun.. BUT it seems like you HAVE to purchase to complete sets. Bought the deals on the game and still couldn't get a new sticker! Rolls are hard to come by. The price of the packages is too steep, as well. Make more $1.99 and $2.99, and I would purchase more often! I won't spend the 20 something dollars on a package. And that is BEFORE it's converted to my currency. Rated this a 5 before, but now it's changed to a 3. :( Their Domino Dreams is more exciting but same $$$

I only played this game for a cash app requirement & I hated every single minute of it. I'm finally uninstalling thank goodness! Every single time you load into the game you're bombarded with offers, then I dreaded running out of the dice because the offers would come back, they're really aggressive in trying to get you to buy stuff for the game. Aside from the negative, the reason for my 2☆ is because the art for the game looks nice, & it would be a nicer game to play without the offers

I changed my original rating because last week I received my 200 rolls for a daily check in, but then I had to update the game and it took them away from me... Not only that, but for the last 4-5 days I haven't been able to get on the game. It just stays on the pink Superplay screen. Other than that I love the game and I spend a lot of time and money playing it.. Please fix it!!

Okay.. I do absolutely love this game BUT I am having some issues, for about 2wks now, which im NOT happy about! The game freezes on me all of a sudden. I can hear the music and see the little peons running around still, I just can NOT tap anything at all on the screen. I have lost so many of the trail spins and magic potion turns from the time running out. I have tried uninstalling the game and re-installing it but it still happens. I am NOT very happy at all now!!

Every time you complete a task or run out of dice they throw half a dozen pop ups for transactions at you. Luckily, I don't keep a payment method on my account because sometimes they pop up while you're rolling, and I've clicked more than once prompting me to purchase. I just want to play a game, not dodge pop-ups.

I was loving this game since the beginning, but then I didn't get my huge reward for placing 3rd in a tournament and now I can't get to an actual person or someone to send my reward. I've been trying to reach someone all day. The game is glitchy at times, but I overlooked that because of how fun the game is. I would love to rate this higher but the customer service and support is lacking big time!

Dice buddies is a great game you can steal coins from opponent players and they can steal from you. You can also play against friends as well and they actually make it possible to get more rolls in order to get more coins and be able to progress and move forward without spending your actual cash. Highly recommend if your looking for a game to pass the time with and genuinely just want a game that you don't have to spend your money on just to be able to keep playing..

You need to come up with a different way to trade cards. I'm not adding a bunch of random strangers on my Facebook to make this happen. It doesn't matter how many sticker packs you buy, you'll never get a new card. It's impossible to complete the promotional mini games unless you play 24/7 and spend money buying rolls. Basically the more you play the more they screw you over.

It's a great game. It is for anyone of any age. I like the paper, rock, scissors a lot 👍. I've been playing for a couple years now, and only thing I would change on this game is the pop ups when the game starts up. It's too many, we get the hint that your advertising your offers, but the pop ups aren't gonna make em buy them. Maybe cut some of em out. But great game y'all.

So much fun, I forget the time!!!! Yes, it is silly.but so worth it!!!! You get to explore and build kingdoms, who wouldn't love that. It's 10/8/22@6:17pm, I love the game but now I updated and I can't play at all, I bought $20.99 package earlier this morning, went back to sleep. I'm ready to play after my daily errands and the game won't start, I turn off my phone, went to Google play to open the game, nothing. I'm frustrated and out of 21 dollars, please help.

Update: The rating is going down because when I have to close and restart the game 5 or more times when playing because it constantly freezes, it's no longer fun to play I have been playing this game for over a year and have enjoyed it, however now I can't seem to use my coins to buy to new stickers with the new albums. So bc I'm not going to pay to buy more rolls I loose a ton of coins. Also I wish they would make it faster when you are getting the prizes. It's so annoying and takes so long.

I downloaded this game and quickly got addicted! It was a great game, but then I bought a booster pack.. it quickly became a pay to play game. You could no longer get anywhere without buying boosters, which is ok except the prices kept going up! Before I knew it, I had spent over $1,000 trying to play the game and keep my "pets." Suddenly, it started glitching, I buy dice in the evening, wake up the next day and have no dice! I go to bed first in the tournament and wake up with no rewards!

I liked the game at first, nice little discretion. Brights since rolls from time to time, but what I've noticed is the algorithms are missed up, it doesn't give me good spins unless I purchase, plus why am I purchasing for someone else to come steel my coins, and it's the amount as well. I'm very much heavy on deleting this game. 😞

This is absolutely one of my MOST FAVORITE GAMES. IT ABSOLUTELY ADORABLE AND I LOVE ALL THE DETAILS THEY PUT INTO IT. ITS GREAT FOR ALL AGES. They have a lot of tournaments and mini games on the side to keep it interesting. You can purchase items but they make it so as long as you play and keep up on it, you really don't need too. And, that's wonderful for people that don't have extra money for extra gameplay. And, the are brief at the end of your rolls & you just click "X" quickly &closes.

The best (dice - board -spin ) game I've played so far . ( And I've played a lot) Quick update : I've finished a tournament in the 3rd place two days ago and haven't received my rewards yet . I contacted customer service twice but still nothing ( no reply at all ) Not that this would change my mind about the game i still love it I'm just disappointed that my efforts in that tournament have gone to nothing.

The only reason I'm not giving a full 5 stars is due to the adds always telling you to buy more dice, that and how long it takes to finish a kingdom the further you get. Other than that, this is a game of pure luck, chance, attacking friends kingdoms and stealing their gold to build, but it's fun :) I'll keep playing til I tire of it :P Thanks developers for keeping it interesting but please dial back on the dice buying ads.

This is fun with the attacks, steals, and fights...the only criticism I have is how hard it is to get friends, other games can search and send requests... Then you can accept or decline requests(so can they) This one is too difficult to get friends...I still haven't figured it out, and the card trading seems impossible--i don't want to have to friend people on Facebook...other than that, it's fun

Meh, overall. Obviously have to spend money, and you can't even trade the Gold stickers. What a waste of time. The Facebook Group has very unprofessional admins as well. I do not reccomend this game unless you like a million pop-ups and the game pretty much begging you for money. There is barely any variety to the in game experience past Kingdom 8. Overall, this game is not good nor would I recommend it. I also noticed the odds are never in your favor If you try to bet high. It's purposeful.

I think this is the first review I've left on an app but it's frustrating to constantly have the game not save your progress. I've built buildings and left the game to only have the game not save the progress more than once. I also created a ticket within the game and never heard back. As a result, I've uninstalled the game. I think the developers should be cognizant about certain issues brought up by users

This app has made time fly it's so fun, and the levels are not impossible. Meaning it's easy to gain coins to build, and the promotions they offer won't cost you a arm and leg, graphics are very well and there's no annoying ads. Over all I give it a five ⭐ allowing you to game on the go great for friends to get together as well I hope you have as much fun ☺️ as I have with this app and easy in app purchases.

So this is just a clone of monopoly go with a few new gameplay elements. I wouldn't mind, except they took all of the annoying and predatory elements and turned it up to 11. Opening the app, using your very limited dice, will give you no less than 12 pop-ups. Spend $6 and you might get 30 minutes of gameplay, or just 1 minute with no progress. Watch a full ad, and it rewards a laughable 4 dice. I downloaded for the free cash ap and I'll surely uninstall after I reach level 21.

when I first started 2 years ago ....Love this game! Alot better than coin master, only issue is I think you could give us Shields in our chest or anywhere other than just by rolling them or even put them in the many offers to purchase, needs to give more shields!! but now the pop ups to buy stuff are too much!!!! makes it nit fun!! I've blown enough money on this game!!! and the packages are listed on the right side so why not stop the pop up ones!!!!

Been playing this game for a few weeks now and it's been thoroughly enjoyable. Lots of fun. Seems people can basically buy their top spot in the different contests though which I don't agree with. Good app overall. EDIT: I've been playing this game for a while now and it's become a part of my daily routine. Get up, grab coffee, play Dice Dreams until I run out of turns. Might me 20 minutes but often it's up to and over an hour. Love the game.

It's a standard gahca-style game, heavily laden with tons of micro transactions and not so micro transactions. The amount of pop-ups to buy stuff is insane, it will cycle through 3 or 4 pop ups to buy stuff before going back to the game. Seriously... I don't know how people play this. I started getting angry because the pop ups take so long and cannot be permanently dismissed. Terrible design...

First, you have these adorable creatures depending on you to rebuild their kingdoms! You are their only hope! Roll and earn coin to use for building. Play other little many games to earn prizes or free rolls. My only complaint is when you run out of rolls, it flashes up several things wanting you to purchase. Other than that the game is fun! Attack others, steal others coins, rock, paper, scissors mini game. What more could you ask for!?

You don't have to spend abunch of money to pay this game for quite awhile. It's kind of addictive love this game..... editing review. I'm going to delete this game. I've had several times where it glitches and I didn't get the prize I should've. One time they fixed it and compensated me appropriately and another they didn't. Twice I was just about to feed my pet poof it was gone and the 99 plus cookies were just gone. I am spending too much. My fault will delete.

I played this game daily; several times a day. They give a daily gift box w/a few pink boxes that give larger gifts mostly on days 4 & 7. Occasionally I would get the first pink box but most often if the pink box was next up it would start me over at the day 1 box. I contacted support & they answer unasked questions w/o touching on my issue. They wear you out with 3-4 minimum "sale" pop-ups when you sign in & throughout the game. I purchased a few that were very inexpensive. Just uninstalled it.

This is the most annoying, worthless and mindless game that I've ever played. I was playing it to gain rewards and I couldn't wait to finish the tasks so I could uninstall and be rid of it. There is a constant barrage of ads each time there is a transition and it's beyond irritating. You will be able to get a good few minutes of game play on a rare occasion, but the only way to get more than a minute of action you'll need give in to the assault of micro transactions and spend your money.

It's the worst game I've played so far . I thought it might be better then coin master , but god it's worse . It was good at the beginning, but now , the adds , deals , and discounted purchases makes it unplayable , and you are going no where if you don't pay those greedy scammers . It's a big no for me , I'll stick with coin master . At least it's more enjoyable and much more better then this one , no comparison needed

Rarely have I encountered a game that fights so hard to keep you from playing it. The constant offer pop-ups were getting enraging, but then they got so bad because of a recent event the app actually started locking up. If I wasn't being offered money in return for play I would have uninstalled within the first few hours.

I like the game, but there are WAY too many deals or offers to spend money that interrupt your game. Everytime you change tasks in game you're stuck going through ALL the many deals for 5 minutes. It's irritating and the deals aren't really even very good! Also it's very hard to advance once your past the 1st 20-25 levels and they don't increase the prize amounts. They make it to where you almost have to spend real $ to advance.

Don't play this game. I understand these games are to make money but my god. If you run out of rolls you have to wait for SIX different, slow to load screens for ever possible way you can pay them for more. I just sat through 15 of those different screens before I could even "play" the game. The gameplay is lacking at best.

I love this game and it's really cute but, unfortunately, it's really annoying that whenever I'm out of rolls at least 5 offer pop ups occur and I get mad while trying to close all of them. This happens every single time, not just once. Plase stop it. I don't wanna quit the game for good but sometimes I think of it. Also, we have to wait for new rolls for too long. Maybe you may consider shortening the time. I would appreciate it. Thanks.

This game will get your heart racing after the first few minutes of getting to know what you've got to do. So, don't rate the game before you play it. It's a little different than most of those cartoon games that have a character for each level and different levels to earn rewards on each level. Don't rate it before you play it! That's my moto!

I have been playing for a couple of months. This game is addicting!! I fell in love with the little peons. The "run for your lives" when you're attacking and the giggles when you blow up while you're trying to steal coins is just too cute! I had a couple of other games that I played regularly but Dice Dreams is my go to game now!! PEON POWER!!

Was one of my top favorite games I absolutely had a marvelous time playing it but now there's this thing that I have noticed lately as a player and for the world of me I don't understand what the purpose of the free advertisement watch for if the player only gets 10 dice and I have been a long time lover of the app for a long time as well as purchase items when required but it doesn't make sense to add additional advertising just to get ten dice. Honestly you guys have to consider that it.

Edit # idk 3 or 4. They give 25 dice to rate the game. As always, It's still 5 stars. I still love playing this game. Support responds rather quickly and they hook you up with things for the game sometimes when they respond. You really don't have to buy anything to play the game. I do though, cause they have amazing deals. I play the game through mist play so when I do buy something it helps me on there too. The content of the game itself is unique and fun. I definitely love this game!

I had originally given this game 5 stars but had to change it. I never had issues before but since the update it's been frozen. I haven't been able to get on and play for 2 days! I've missed cashing in my gems and my kingdom is probably destroyed. It'll cost so much to repair it. I love playing this game when it works but this is ridiculous! Very disappointed 😞

Fun game suitable for younger children. Very colorful and fun activities with almost no long ads- there are a few pop-ups. Coins are earned quickly, and you can create buildings in the kingdoms easily. You can also move around the spaces to discover objects and small creatures-- entertaining and very kid-friendly. I have only played through level two, but I haven't needed to buy anything to move forward.

I like the game. But it is too difficult to keep dice, frequently have to stop playing unless you spend tons of money in purchases. Bullseye target needs to be recalibrated. Sometimes it gives you a 2x when offset, but will only give a 1.5 when exactly centered. Other times it's the opposite, more of a bi-polar result depending on mood. Too much to earn, cards gained are pointless, sets rarely completed. Diamonds rarely given, etc. Pay out from kickcash are false they do not keep their word.

I deleted this game! It was HORRIBLE for POP-UP ADS. When you open the game, there are at least 12 of them AT LEAST. When you change screens, there are pop-up ads, and again, a lot of them. Some of them repeatatively! When you get to the last few rolls.... POP-UP ads! The game is boring on top of that. You don't have to do anything to play because you can set the dice on auto roll.
