The game would freeze and then close but my screen would still be stuck. At one point it wouldn't let me open the app itself. I tried giving it a second chance recently thinking It'd be fixed by now but no luck.

I don't usually stick with a game for long but I really like Dice Dreams! I play it through Mistplay, so I get points on that app as well and it's really cool to actually earn rewards playing something that holds my attention. The characters are really cute and game sounds are pleasant. It's easy to play and to bounce back if you aren't able to play regularly... I don't feel like I'm constantly losing or behind like with most games. I'm very pleased with this game! Keep up the good work! :)

I would have given 5 stars but for the last month or 2, I have had numerous problems with the game, like it not crediting me what I roll, like the incentive dice, half the time it doesn't give them when rolled, it's frustrating considering they are not frequent and you are trying to complete the task. Not getting the rewards from a tournament even after contacting customer service! Also when contacting customer service they ask for gamer ID but it doesn't let you enter the proper fomat!

I have been playing this game for a few years now and it use to be a favorite. However, the game play has gone down so much! There's 4-8 pop ups to buy dice Everytime . The lollipops, pearls, and honeycombs are absolutely ridiculous. Why would I win 999+ of those items but can only spend 30- 60 of them then have to buy 1 to get 2 more for free and then do it again. This game has gotten very money hungry and it's a shame The Chuck challenges are a pain and impossible to complete even with "super"

Alright. Pretty alright. I like dice kingdoms better though. Interesting gameplay though, very clever that the more rolls you have, the more they let you use at a single roll. I had almost 300 rolls accrued to unlock a 25x booster which is about 12 spins. I luckily got a free roll one, which allowed for a lot more, but you see how it could turn almost 100 rolls with a 3x boost into 12. Crazy. Very tricky. Devious, really.

I like the regular game play, but it gives too many cards... Attack, steal, and fight. I especially hate the fight card against another player. It took almost 100 rolls of the dice to get a shield card today. I like the game, but I don't love it. There's no way that I would pay any money for any extras based on the annoying game play. That trail thing was super irritating too. I kept going and going and never seemed to get anywhere.

Bought the puzzle piece offer since I was close to finishing the final level (which I did receive, finished puzzle, collected the prize, was able to use the rolls won to finish trail which gave me the cookies to complete pet. Had almost 30k rolls. Then the game crashed and restarted..and I was exactly where I had been before the purchase. no puzzle pieces, no rolls, nothing. Just $4 less in my account. Support never replied, so I requested a refund through play store. They refunded immediately.

This game is VERY addicting. I thought it was just going to be another pointless game that takes forever to get through each round. But the longer you wait, the more you get to do when coming back to finish building your towns or start a new town. The ONLY thing I don't like & the reason I'm giving 4 stars is when you run out of rolls there are TOO MANY ads back to back. I'll exit 3 and think I'm done then 2 more will pop up. Fix this & I'll update my stars to 5! Other then that, it's GREAT!

overall fine, no forced ads. but the constant pop-ups of in game promotions is A LOT. They only happen when you open the app and when you run out of rolls but 5+ pop ups that can't be skipped and prompt you to spend real money is too much. Maybe if they only happened when you open the app, I could get past it.

The app is constantly backing out and you have to reload the game. It's very slow to load and most times it will kick you off before you even get a chance to play. Sometimes it will take you to Google play store just to make you reopen and reload the game. It was fine at first but now it's just annoying and more so aggravating. Please fix this problem

For a game that claims it wants you to play it, it does everything it can to prevent you from playing it. You get 10 micro transaction pop ups before you can even get to rolling dice and then if you auto-roll, once you get to your last roll, you get 10 other micro transaction pop ups. The game looks good, and IS fun when you can play it, but the amount of time and aggravating you deal with just isn't worth installing. Monopoly Go is guilty of it but not as obnoxious about it. They do 3 not 10

I downloaded this game about 2-3 months ago and have been playing pretty consistently. Made it to the 30th level or so by now and it feels like my rolls are all for coins now. I remember rolling way more question cards and a lot less money. Which was fun because money is ultimately pretty useless to the actual gameplay. I would prefer playing one of the mini games for money than getting it from jackpot after jackpot. I spent a little money on some rolls and all I got was coins it was boring.

the more you spend the prices keep rising. it's getting to the point I cannot afford to purchase more power ups. now it wants me to update, if I do I lose all the credits I have from an on-going challenge. further more when I'm not paying auction the game will automatically change my bid and I lose all my credits. too me not fair play. otherwise I love the game, fun and addictive! if I have to update I'm done.

The game has a good interface but the constant popup request for in game purchases are horrible. As soon as I open the app I get between 3 to 5 popups back to back. And when you run out of rolls, you are hit with at least 3 more popups. I do not intend on spending money on this app. Asking multiple times within a minute does not make me want to spend money any more than the previous times asked.

It is a simple game but sometimes the bots get 5k on the rankings like on the Spanish tournament or whatever. I like this game but you can't just show all the offers everytime you run out of rolls, we can click it you know. Also it won't let me send friend request which should be their even if you don't have friends. That's all for now, thanks for making this game. 🤑

It's a fun game to play but you don't always get your rewards and when you contact support with the info they always say they can't verify it and give you a consolation "gift" which is nothing near what you were supposed to get in rewards from playing. And I hate that some levels are set up so that you can't advance to win rewards unless you spend money, not to mention that the grand prize rewards are pretty much impossible to get unless you buy one of the packages. Fun but disappointing 😞

Once the dice rolls are depleted to zero, 5 to 6 purchase pop-ups happen and to invite friends to play, which gets really annoying. They are all covering each side of the screen in play mode already and don't need to be bombarded with them. I don't need to be reminded. When there are coins or dice to gain, 99% of the time is money, when it's dice that's wanted.

This game is a ton of fun! The graphics are adorable! My only con is that unless you decide to in app purchase, most days I can't play for very long. Which is unfortunate, I Play a couple games where on good days I'll be playing for a hour+ just by maximizing my rolls with the multiplier. With this game, MOST days, not every, I'll be thru my free rolls within 10 min or so, that's a bummer! UPDATE: most days they've done great with allowing longer free play All in all,its a fun, addicting game.

Much improved since my last review. But I still don't use facebook and I'm not going to start. Hope the daily gift isn't just a temporary thing that's going to be gone in a week. To the point though, it's a throw away game with no real gameplay or story, but it's fun to pass the time since all the "events" only seem to last 1-2 days. I guess to try and encourage buying dice to progress... but what's the point, and why should I care what board I'm on it's all basically the same.

This game used to be so much fun until I stopped receiving trails & treasure hunts that most others have. I'm not the only player not receiving them...we see a pop-up about it, hit the "lets go" link, then nothing. I've uninstalled/reinstalled, cleared the cache, restarted the phone, restarted the game, nothing works. I've sent screenshots to support & get no response whatsoever. It's pointless to even try to get help! They also reduced the number of sends/day from 10 to 5 with last update.

Game was OK, kinda repetitive, but after linking my Facebook account a random person started attacking my village nonstop, way more than six times a day, so I could no longer progress through the game. I tried blocking that person and unlinking my FB acct and there's no way in the app to do either, so I blocked the app in FB but it still had my info. Their TOS says if you don't like them storing you acct info forever, don't use their apps and services, so I won't. Deleted.

Pushes ads for up to 6 in-game purchases before and after gameplay. The same repeated game play, just the map you're on can change. Limited turns per hour means limited play time in which you can be done in less than a minute, then you can take up to 5 turns in another hour. As soon as the app loads it will push up to 6 screens on you to make in-app purchases. If your dice fall below your mulitplier it will push the same screens. Cute graphics are the only good thing about the game.

I left once because it was buggy and wouldn't let me move forward. I came back a long time later because Mistplay wants me to. This time the bug is it let's you roll for about 5-10minutes, them the pop-ups trying to get you to purchase start popping up over and over. You cannot access the roll button because the pop-ups start again as soon as you touch it. Unplayable.

It's a win win game! I don't have to watch my dice count. I don't have to watch my money count. Really simple n lots of fun game I'm editing my review. There is sometimes well correction ,a lot of the times the games that they offer for everyone to play everyday besides building up your kingdom you can't get to them. Why? This game has so many offers to buy packages to get more rolls etc. Because they're so many of the offers it's really hard to get to play them. The offers cover the side GAMES

I've played several land building type games. Dice Dreams is definitely one of my favorites. I love the graphics and the creativity of each level. The Peons are adorable and interactive. Tap on them and see what they do. Another level of entertainment, discovery of secret effects. I wouldn't mind if the developers wanted to explore more into that area.

Originally gave this game 3 stars because I like it, but I didn't get my dice rolls when my friend signed up using my invite even though I followed all the steps correctly. The developer responded to my review and said I could email to resolve the issue. NEVER HEARD BACK. Tried to give the benefit of the doubt and invited a second friend, STILL NO DICE ROLLS GIVEN. Don't waste your time, it's a cash grab anyway. Annoying pop-ups basically forcing transactions on you constantly. I'm over it!

Played this game for money on Freecash. This game was fun after I got rid of all the pop ups begging me to spend money as soon as I opened the app!!! That was SUPER ANNOYING!!! Then, as soon as you run out of dice, guess what? The SAME pop-ups about spending money get shoved on your face again. I can't count all the times I accidentally clicked on them, and had to cancel the payments on Google play, just when I was trying to click on something else. Stop all that, and this game will be alright.

I enjoy the simplicity of the game and the graphics and themes. I gave 4 stars however because there are two things that are holding the game back from being truly fun. 1- The dice is shaped as a 6 sided dice, however theres essentially 8 sides to it. Making it very hard to believe that any roll is actually random, it seems preprogrammed to make you unable to progress easily. Just change shape of the dice! 2. Choose friends kingdoms to attack. I dislike attacking inactive friends.

When I first downloaded this game I loved it. It was super fun to trade cards with all the new friends I made but they have now made it impossible to finish the album without spending a ton of money. They have given no new cards lately and have had no golds to be traded. The glitches are unreal and when you spend money and glitches happen it just sets you back. Such a bummer as it was such a great game before they got money hungry.

Love this game! It's a lot of fun, comparable to Coin master in my opinion! You roll dice and depending on what you roll can get coins, more rolls, attack steal raid or fight other players! It even has an option to revenge players who have attacked your kingdom! I love it! And you do not have to purchase anything to advance! It may take a little time but your rolls always replenish and your able to continue to kingdom to kingdom without having to spend money!

I got a notification to my phone via Dice Dreams itself to rate in the app store for 1000 rolls, and never got them. I really wanted to finish the event that was going on at the time, I was so close to getting my next reward. I waited a few days because I figured even if I didn't get those rolls to help with the event I wanted to progress further in, it would have helped with the new event. I'm super bummed about it; I'll change this review once I haven't been lied to if I don't just uninstall.

I definitely enjoy this game daily! I can spend $ if I like or not, lots of rewards and gifts given freely! If you want to watch ads for free rolls you can. I've only paid for the piggy bank once but will not make it a habit. Piggy banks annoy me! They do throw alot of packs at you while playing too, which is also very annoying, but I still play and do enjoy this game anyway!

The graphics are bright and cheery. The sound effects are adorable and motivational. The story line is easy to follow and each level is cuter than the last. I am only playing this game to earn credits on another app, but I must say I do like it. 4 Stars because this app gives a small amount of credits to MeetMe, I mind as well just spend My money there than waste it on a game that gives me 35 credits for 1 hour of dice dreams. Smh what a joke.

I have played phone games for over decade. I can say without a doubt, this game has the most obnoxious cash shop I've ever seen. If U run out of dice, U have to close several pop-ups & this will happen a dozen + times a day. The game looks great, and it's okay for a casual game, but like most games on the phone this just a carbon-copy of Coin Master BUT it does it better, so there's that.

I know my opinion isn't going to make a difference but there's TOO MANY IN-APP PURCHASE POP-UPS. You have to close out of several before making your rolls, when you run out of dice the same ones pop back up, etc. I don't understand why free games have to be stingy by annoying players with ads. Food for thought, if you're going to keep all the annoying ads, at least make their be an option to purchase a NO AD mode.

This game is one of my favorite pastimes. It combines an exciting game mechanic of chance with a relaxing game play style. You progress through kingdoms and challenge your friends to get money to progress. Despite attacking other people, Dice Dreams has you focus mainly on building on your own kingdoms, so it isn't toxic at all. Also, unlike other kingdom building games, it has side missions to help you progress, and cute, fantasy characters that set it apart from other games' characters.

UPDATE...everything was made right within 1 day of posting this review. Love most games of this type, but Dice Dreams is def my fav. Only qualm is woth the sticker collecting. Opened 100s of chests w/no news in about a month. I enjoy playing the game, and its one of the very few i spend money on. However recently i purchased the Fabulous Pack for 10.99 (12.01 after tax) and did not receive. Intried contacting support thru game as instructed 3 days ago and have gotten no response...

This game is super fun to play and a lot of times I find myself not able to pull myself away. It has a well designed play action with several mini games inside of the actual main game. You do not need a ton of money to play, if any at all. My only complaint is that, before play can start and if you run out of rolls or parts for other mini games....it has a ton of "offers" that you have to look at and click out of to get to to main play. The offers are not that great for the $. 4****

I've definitely cut down my playing time lately.. not as fun as before. You have become greedy and made everything about money. The game has made it near impossible to get the harder cards with the recent album. It sucks the fun out of the game! It's impossible for me to complete any of my events events or challenges now. It has become less enjoyable for us all. Mine also has a glitch, and the compensation is not worth it for the money I spent. Furthermore, dice refill takes forever.

Abysmal Played this game for over two years and decided to change devices. On opening the game on my new phone I was met with the surprise that all my achievements and leveling up was for nothing. No save games or anything. Waste of time and money Save yourself the hassle and don't bother installing. Any support from the developer is just words

This game is fun and well made, but whenever you run out of rolls you get a slideshow presentation of microtransactions. If you upgrade a building and get more rolls you'll run out again and get the same microtransactions thrown in your face. It is very annoying. EDIT: Now after a new update (I'm guessing) the game crashes every minute, and forces you to go through the microtransactions everytime you restart the game, making the game unplayable.

You guys make it impossible to get pets. I'm not one to purchase anything. Not everyone can. Make it easier for people who play every day but can't afford to purchase anything. It's ridiculous. And the bubble stuff is pointless. If you're gonna make us buy stuff, make the free stuff at least worth it. Plus, you guys keep highjacking the prices after you reach a certain level. I'm still gonna play the game, but make it better for people who can't purchase. also let us add friends in game, not FB!

Love this game, by far my favorite.. lately it's been glitching with the invite link, it won't work, then I don't get the friend bonus, or double during the event. Changing stars and review. The game is getting worse and worse with rewards. I won 300 dice and 50M on progress bar, and neither showed up. Now I'll have to wait days for support to get back to me. This is happening very often as of lately. Wish they would fix it so it would be better again

Just be careful because this game is very addicting You will invest a lot of time and money into it and if something goes wrong customer support doesn't care. I did an update like the game suggested and suddenly the upgrades I worked very hard on were not there anymore in my kingdom. I reached out to customer support, they tried to tell me they couldn't find a problem and unwilling to reimburse the coins that they stole from me instead of making it right would rather lose a player. Uninstalled.

I love the cute styles of each of the worlds and I love you can get pretty far without needing to buy anything. However these last couple days, the game has stopped detecting any input on my behalf and I've lost out on countless steals and attacks this way, as well as a good chunk of cookies for my pet. This forces me to reset the game and I lose out on what I would have done. I have to do this upwards of 9 times before finishing all my dice rolls.

I love this game but as for the last couple of updates, it freezes up more and more and as of today, I can get in just to get passed a couple of pop-ups and not be able to play at all. Frustrating. Please fix this. I have forced stopped the game, cleared the cache, turned my phone off and back on after a few minutes and it has not improved but gotten worse. The only other thing I think of that I can do is uninstall to reinstall but then I'll lose everything from Mistplay. Once fixed I'll 5 star.

I LOVE the game. But, the app constantly crashes (and I even turned the graphics down). And the amount of in app ads is absolutely atrocious! Every time you run out of rolls you have to exit out of anywhere from 5 to 8 ads. I got my husband to play and he eventually gave up because of the amount of ads. It's honestly ridiculous...

Fun! Great graphics! Easy to build and have fun for hours! !!UPDATE!! Summer 2024. I still really like this game. Besides what I already noted in my first review, after playing for some time I'll add. I like that there are minigames and tournaments on side. Adds up extra coins and Sometimes you'll get a few dice while you're playing those games to help you get more free dice. OVERALL it's the best dice board game of it's kind! I compare all similar games and this is GOAT! Dice Dreams 🎲

This game is fun but it glitches and freezes up at witch point you may loose items when you have to log in again. Also the pets are cute but impossible to earn unless you actually pay money to feed them. I have earned one pet and working on another but finding it hard to finish pet levels in the apprpriate amount of time. Now I can't get into the game at all. My other games work so I know it is not on my part. I want an option for working for pets.

The is a awesome game. Love you can attack friends. But, the friend add is awful. You are friends with people but it doesn't automatically give you a option to add them. There should be a drop down with friends that play and you should be able to select from there.. Having to contact support with both players ID'S is a hassle. You should get bonus rolls for additional friends regardless, the chances of free rolls, and the ratio to "bet" equivalent to rewards are very low. Overall great game.

So. Many. Popups. Also, if the timers for the advantages you can win didn't count down constantly then this app would be bearable. Imagine having a 10 minute buff that makes everything 15% cheaper, but you finish a kingdom with not much time left, then you will most likely waste the rest of the timer from the 10 pop-ups that come up for the new kingdom.

This is such an exciting game to play! You have so many events that come up daily and almost hourly if you play plenty. A little money spent in the game for a pack goes great into the mix because you can save them and spread them out in a few days. Play enough rolls just to maximize the shields and don't come back until you get hit. Very eye catching with the graphics and colors.

I already made contact through the app and they haven't reply since the 17thIt has now been 24 days and I've contacted everyone you've told me multiple times.....Buyer beware! I spent $35 on a package on January 1st and still have not received what I purchased, nor have I been refunded my money! Customer support is spotty they have only responded they were "looking into it" twice. If the issue is resolved, I will change my review.

loved this game . But recently the game just will exit itself off and I have to reopen the app and loose progress. Also I paid for dice and it took the money and didn't give me what I had paid for . I got my order receipt and sent them the number and the receipt, no big deal thinking they would fix it. they opened my conversation and then closed out the convo instead of fixing it. On top of that they charge my card again and still nothing when I brought it to their attention.

cute game but way too many pop ups. it gets annoying. every time I open the game I get at least 6 pop ups wanting me to spend money. I would think that if I clicked out of it once that should indicate i'm not interested in spending money. but no. you get them EVERY SINGLE TIME. sometimes even in the middle of playing. I would give it 5 starts if it weren't for all the pop ups.

I wake up in the morning and immediately need to check my Kingdom! I absolutely Love my little Minions❤️! There so cute they are probably the thing I love the most about playing.. There is always something new and exciting about this game- The graphics are awesome- I never get bored with this game! And with so many levels, I am always looking forward to winning and building bigger and better kingdoms. Dice Dreams is my new favorite!🤩

I was really enjoying playing this game however it has started glitching really bad. Now it's even gotten to the point that anytime I attempt to open the game it freezes up on me or kicks me out almost immediately. Can't even get through the beginning prompts. I've done all updates, cleaned my cookies and cleaned the cache. About to just uninstall and forget about it. It's gotten rather annoying!

Love this game, I wish I could roll all day. That's 1 downfall tho, is this game has definitely prompted me to spend more money then I have ever spent on a game, so be careful. Its definitely monitized to make u want to spend money on rolls. I suggest not buying from the store, but waiting for the deals that pop up. Much better deal

Decent game, frustrating pop ups. Often I'll lose stuff I'm trying to get because there's limits, but I'll win too many through different avenues, and it won't let me use them between. Edit as response: it's not just when you run out of rolls. I often have to have 3-5 chests open with different items inside, then we open stickers, get pet feed (which often gets deleted if the chests gave 150 each, you can only hold 500 so you lose it). Pop ups for these rewards it what made me uninstall

Update edit! I have NEVER been one to purchase items in a game ... But I got sucked in and have spent probably about $40 of my own money. But the last couple times I have purchased promotions... It was TERRIBLE! I won't spend more than 2-3 dollars at any given time... But at first it was worth it. But the last time I spent money out of the 150 rolls I only got 1 attack, NO shields, and 2 rolls with the surprise items. What a WASTE! Happened last 2 or 3 times I purchased. Not worth paying.

I used to love this game but now I have mixed feelings. My biggest frustration is the impossible nature of getting shields. As you progress in the game you don't increase how many you have. It is seems impossible to get them with dice rolls. I just was playing and rolled around 50 times without a single roll being shields. It makes me not want to play because I know my progress will just be lost due to the shields. Either they should be more likey to be rolled or have another way to get them.

There really isn't any 'game' to this game. You just press the roll button over and over again. Occasionally you play rock-paper-scissors against an AI. Occasionally there is a timing challenge. But, there is no skill or decisions here. The ads are also obnoxious to an insane degree. Run out of dice and get 10 separate adds telling you to buy more, one right after the other. Events are a joke too and don't even tell you possible rewards besides the current one and the final reward. Graphics OK.

I played this when it first came out and loved it. Redownloaded it after some time away, and the pop ups upon start up are out of control. As soon as you open the app, you get anywhere from 8-13 popups before you can even play. You should be able to click a box and say don't show again, it's so annoying I'm seriously considering uninstalling the game. Games like Monopoly Go have popups but they aren't as bad as this Dice Dreams

Doesn't give you the points that you earn. I've emailed a couple of times that it wasn't registering my points.....they said I had to be patient. It's not registered practically anything since the beginning of March. If you add up the points beside each game it doesn't reflect what they have at the top of the app. Waste of time. Started off good

I love this game and enjoy playing it. However, there are 2 things about it that I dislike. First, when the game loads, you are bombarded with pop ups that want you to make in-app purchases. Second, there are some bugs that cause you to lose progress or not get rewarded for playing in-game tournaments. If it was not for these problems, I would continue playing without concern.

The game is good ; but the pet is ridiculous. I was just shy of getting my first pet again for the 5th time. ....and bam, new pet. All that hard work and purchasing of different things to gain cookies. I paid $5.99 for a special cookie prize, and then it's gone. It wasn'tworth it for me to waste money on somethingI could have gotten for 1.99 .. You lose all of that. Doesn't transfer ,it just disappears. I think this game is about to go in the delete pile.

Really fun game, I just wish the dice generated more per hour. Its fun to get bonuses and gifts throughout the day by adding the game in social media platforms too. Update. Lots of glitches and I'm disappointed that my gems were taken and I didn't get my reward during my event. I also spun 10,000 steps on the trail and my game froze so my steps were not taken.

I like the game but way too many pop-up ads asking you to spend money. Can't play the game because of being too busy closing ads lol. I counted 10 pop-ups when I had 2 dice left and as soon as I used them I got the SAME 10 POPUPS. The star rating will go up when you make it less annoying to play. I am not the only one since the majority or your reviews are about the crazy amount of pop-up ads. I understand you need to make money but once or twice is enough to get the point lol.

If you prefer games that have low achievement rates, slow paced progress and cost tons of money to really get anywhere then this game is NOT FOR YOU! This game is fun, engaging, fast paced, and you DON'T need to spend money to quickly move up. you'll never get bored!! your always winning huge prizes that allow you to keep playing, it's not hard to build your levels quickly, your game play replenishes in no time, you interact with other players very often and can even brag when you win! Enjoy!!

I purchased a pack for $20 and that pack was never rewarded, and the way theyake you contact them in the app doesn't work. I haven't received contact back from the team yet, but I have screenshots of everything. If I receive contact and my issue is rectified I will give this app five stars, because the gameplay is fun, but I can not imagine I'm the only person they've scammed for $20.

WAY TO MANY pop-up offers just to get started at the beginning of every play, I counted seven minimum sometimes more when there are new events. It makes you lose interest in playing the game at all when you have to go through seven to 10 windows just to start a game. It's not just at the intro. It's every single time you open the app. Very discouraging.

It's a pretty cute, mindless game, and it's actually surprisingly addicting. I don't usually play a lot of mobile games like this, but the animations and music are really cute and it's pretty simple with a bit of a "battle" aspect too for people who like that sort of thing while still feeling a lot like a boardgame. The pop-ups do get a little annoying, but you can just click them away pretty quickly and it's kind of expected for a free mobile game

Awesome visuals- love the artistry of all the kingdoms, peons and other characters. Only issue is that its so much fun that I've spent way too much money to keep playing this game during and since the pandemic. Still paying off debt incurred playing the game a year ago. Fantastic game that just keeps getting better- I feel a part of it due to how much I have invested in it!!!!!

I loved playing this game at first probably a little too much. spent a lot of money and a loyal customer until the last 72hrs when I had 2 different glitches affect my ability to play properly and si I missed out on getting my last card of the album. most definitely not prompt responses either from the makers. so mad, sad and disappointed.

Sooo cute. Love the Peons. Horrible progression- they offer you an album that does not load. Once the offer to give you an album occurs, there is no way to get past the album "play video"screen that pops up when opening the game. It just say "Oh snap". While I sit idle unable to progress my kingdom was destroyed and all my coins stolen. This game is useless now. No way to play past this hiccup.

This is a fun game. I like the playful graphics and sounds and that you can watch a video a couple times to get a couple extra dice when you run out before you have to wait an hour for more. I'm on a limited income, so I don't do in-app purchases. I don't mind choosing to watch an ad for continued play, I just hate them when you have to watch one after every single turn. This game doesn't do that. So play is enjoyable.

This is by far the best game I've ever had on mobile!! I've been playing since the very first year and it's never gotten dull! Love the game and interface is fun and playful. Progressing in the game is easy and straightforward, and the mini games are great for killing time in between rolls when running out. So addicting, so fun, so clever! Like seriously this game is really cool in so many ways. I love this game. Only thing is to buy stuff at the store is expensive and you really don't get a lot! But still game play is 5 stars!

Great game. Ads are pretty light, but we are bombarded with pop ups way, way too much. If I'm low, or out of dice, I'm given a pop up. This happens twice. When you are low, and when you run out. I'm not really a gamer, but this is the one and 1st game since playing Nintendo64's Donkey Kong game that I've liked so much and spend hours playing. It's not really even a GAME!!! This has been one of the best games I have played. But recently it has gotten harder to be happy with it. Love the game tones but the constant pop ups are unnecessary. It's ok in the beginning but throughout the game? Too many pop ups/prompts to buy more rolls. I gave it a fair try, but the pop ups are the most annoying thing, I've lost interest. And it takes too long for rolls to refill. It gets discouraging after leveling up too--u win less and less. It was fun for first few levels but I'm done now.

I have been very Frustrated with the fact that when I get a good reward, the game glitches and I lose the reward! I'm getting ready to stop playing this game and go to Coin Master for fun play. I'm not happy with the game right now. Very discouraging to new players - Couple of issues to get fixed - Stop the Glitches?

Update: After playing game for 2+ years, I uninstalled. Don't know if it's level I reached or sheer greed of developers, but "sale" packages (the annoying pop-up ones) suddenly jumped in price. When I joined, most packages started at $1.99. Now, cheapest starts at $19.99. I got sucked into spending WAY too much money over past few months. Multiple vows to never purchase again, but would get so close to an achievement that I'd cave. I was thoroughly addicted. Finally had to say enough is enough.

Was fun at first. Started playing for a couple of weeks. Had lots of fun at first but after a few days, I got really annoyed & frustrated at the constant pop ups & having to close multiple windows for "deals" or buying more dice, etc. Every single time you run out or have less than the multiplier is set to, there is at least 5 pop ups. It's a big turn off for me. At least make it optional (like when having icons off to the side or in the shop menus).

Fun and addicting. Cute graphics. Great prizes. Though I could do without the constant prompts to purchase more rolls or packages when I'm out. I don't always have the funds for this and it's annoying to constantly have to "X" out of these menus over and over especially after you e seen them once and know they're available already. Also it's annoying that it takes so long to build up coins. It shouldn't take an hour to get a few coins. Maybe change it to every half an hour.

Used to love the game. Played for over a year. I typically don't rate games, but I appreciate the promotion for this game were almost exactly as the game is played. It's a good game. The only issues I have is it uses up more shields than it should. For example, I had 1 person attack my kingdom and I lost 3 shields. Fun to play. You don't need to spend money to enjoy the game, though you do get ads to purchase packages. Ads aren't too intrusive, which is nice. Still enjoying the game. Froze up and after the 8th attempt at restarting my phone, I realized it wasn't worth it anymore.

I enjoy the game and previously had it rated a 5, however after experiencing some technical issues on the games end and twice having my ticket closed without so much as a response, I'm lowering it by a star. Also, the pop-ups are a little out of control once you run out of rolls. It's fun but I wish the issues were properly resolved.

Game is very fun to play, and has cool rewards and cute characters. The side games are also very fun and interesting. The design of the architecture for the little creatures habitats are a bit too repetitive, and I feel bad when getting the dice roll to have to go steal, or to go destroy another player's kingdoms, even with the revenge choice. But I give it 4/5 stars.

Not a bad game. I like this one better than some other die rolling games. I'm not a fan of the fight even though I do well, I just don't like it. Overall, an alright game but not really my cup of tea.

The game is good to pass the time, very simple and repetitive. Very similar to Monopoly Go, if you've ever played that. However, FAR too many pop-ups FAR too often. I would have given it 4 stars for sure because I liked the game a lot! Up until I updated it this last time it ran smoothly. At first it started freezing up so I'd have to close it & reopen it. . It was very fun to play. I would have given 5 stars but it does have a few bugs. After attack or video, it freezing lots,so you need to restart and you miss the reward. A really fun way to pass some time. Yes you can spend some money to help with buildings or get more rolls. But it isn't a must. They frequently have new events that give hundreds if not tens of thousands in gold. As well as 100 or more extra dice rolls. This game is good. Cute graphics,fast paced when attacking others. You can get coins really fast and upgrade. I dont like that it keeps insisting and i have to x them all the time its annoying. Other than that small pet peeve, this game is entertaining.

Its fun, its mindless and it's cute. I like it. Too much stress in the world and a little relaxing is good but folks, the ad spam is a bit high. Revenue I get, but 4 or 5 hits when logging in and 4 or 5 again when out of rolls just seems a bit excessive. What about perhaps fewer ad splash screens but add an "offers" page to watch ads etc in exchange for rolls/gold/shields etc?

This game is so wonderful and very free player friendly! I've progressed to kingdom 12 in a week and a half and I thoroughly enjoy watching the little kingdoms build up and progress! Of course as the game progresses, it will take longer to build kingdoms, but the adorable graphics make it worth it! The only major downfalls of this game, are the advertising of in-game purchases after every start up opening and after the dice are all used up, it also does not like to function on mobil data. 🥲

I love this game, but i have something that I would like to see improvements on... Been playing for a while now. I enjoy it, but it has wayyyyy too many buy options and other things you have to wade through to play the game! It's irritating and quite ridiculous! Game would be better if there wasn't pop-ups showing up all the time, makes the game totally unplayable. I actually REALLY like this game... It gets better with every new event!!! It's a blend of angry birds, coin master and board games with little twists of it's own... do not play this it is great at first but you got to watch a lot of ads to get free dice and a couple of those ads will kick you right off the game after a few levels the progress stops slows down

While I might play still, I will not be paying for anything for this game.

Horrible! It is filled with so many pay windows that pop up one after the next. Typically 4 or 5 before you can actually play. Oh, and if you are running low on dice, those 4 or 5 pay walls pop up. Even after you refill your dice thru free methods, once you get down to 10 or so dice, bam there is those pay window one after the next. The game would be ok if it were not so aggressively after your money. Uninstall.

I do not like that every time you run out of dice for the amount you are rolling (but have some left), you have to go through 8 ads for more dice/cookies/coins, then when you run out of dice 1 roll later you go through the same 8 ads. Makes it impossible to enjoy the other features like the dice trail or the pearl game. If we need more of anything, they are on the left and right of the screen...no need to continuously hit with 8 ads in the same game played.

This is an incredible game! It's a simple premise with fun gameplay. The luck-based aspect keeps things entertaining without making it too easy to progress. On the subject of luck, it is satisfying to win large amounts of money in this game and build lots of stuff at once. There are absolutely no advertisements forced on you. You only watch ads to win stuff, and the rewards are generous. The ONLY complaint is a minor one: When you run low on rolls, you get 4-5 popups for stuff on sale. Fine tho.

It's a great little game of chance. The one thing I don't like and find very annoying is how I'm encouraged every time I open the app play, close to being out of dice, or when I do run out of dice the options to buy more coin or dice pops up. If it was only one or two options it'd be less annoying, but instead there's at least 3 if not 4 that pop up. Having them pop up several times throughout game play is annoying. Did I say how annoying it is?! Get my drift?

This game is highly addictive, it's fun, you'll get mad when your outta rolls cause your not ready for it to be over. BUT it takes so long for rolls to refill, it lags alot,sometimes when I get an attack or steal it will go to the next screen but freezes and won't let me do anything, I have missed out on alot due to the problem. I do love the game, and the only other issue is all the ads that pop for for the packages u can get. Not everyone has extra money to spend on games.

This game allows for plenty of progression without paying, as long as you have some patience. The animations are top-notch, as well as the overall art direction, making for an eye-pleasing experience. Whoever is doing the art concepts and modeling deserves a raise. The layout and buttons are intuitive, however, I have to knock off 2 stars from the sheer inundation of pop-ups upon first opening the game for the day, as well as when dice rolls run out.

It's a lot of fun and has tons of mini-games, which is great! My only complaint is that keeping dice for any length of time is an absolute impossibility, and with only a few dice regenerating every hour, it takes basically a whole day to completely refill them. By that point, you usually miss out on multiple competitions. If dice regen improved, or getting dice without paying real money became easier, I'd definitely rate higher.

I do enjoy the game. No real skill needed. It is fun and very graphically vibrant. I am not happy that I can not add friends. I was able to send one invite to a new player, we both made sure we were connected to our Facebook accounts and as Facebook friends. We are still unable to find each other on our friends lists. None show on mine so we can't share stickers.

Overall I like this game. Creative, simple easy, I like the city creativity. You see other players, but don't really hurt other players much and they don't hurt you, minor setbacks at most. Plus they have mini games like rock paper scissors and trails. I would make one suggestion to programmers though, supposedly you can trade extra stickers, I have not been able to do so and doubt you can. It would be better sense to recycle extra for new packs like other games do.

I haven't played in a while, but I have recently re-downloaded this game B-Cuz, I *Really* enjoyed it! Update: these ads are getting insane. I understand some but 13 ADS when opening the game is just downright ridiculous. Update: there's still a million ads... 🙄 also now I keep losing my rewards. However, the popups are ridiculous! 4+ ads every time I run out of dice not to mention all of the ads at the beginning. I get the point. I know how to buy more dice if I want to.

This game is so fun. Addicting. The popups of all the same offers is annoying, but doesn't ruin it for me. If there were about 85% less pop-ups before a fully plying the game, it would be a lot more fun. But having to close 3-6 things before playing is absolutely garbage. The game you love to hate. It's a cute game, easy, addictive but there are some issues that I have a problem with. Too many pop ups and promotions, too many buildings to upgrade, too little rewards to upgrade the buildings. I absolutely love this game, when it works. I have a few minor complaints. It freezes up... a LOT. when it freezes up, closing it and reopening it USUALLY fixes it. Then after the pop ups, I have to do the same. To play out my dice and other actions, I have restart at least 10 times. Tone down the pop-ups that cover the sides of the game and maybe I'd give it another star. Other than that, the freezing is an annoyance.

The game is fantastic! Kinda like pirate kings and the like. No forced ads! The ONLY reason it gets 3 stars is because THERE ARE WAY TOO MANY OFFERS TO CLOSE MULTIPLE TIMES THROUGHOUT PLAY! I dont need constant notifications before I can even enjoy the game and all the same ones again when I'm out of rolls (AND AGAIN when nearly out of rolls if the multiplier is on) or the 6 different purchase options I can make that pop up ONE AT A TIME, *EVERY TIME*! Just...no 😑👎

Update... the last couple of days it's been saying something went wrong, and WILL NOT LOAD. Can you please fix the problem!!?!?! Awesome game! Been playing it for a very long time now. Usually don't have any issues with it, only sometimes it freezes on me, but that's any games you play! Always seems you can gets extra rolls by watching video's! Just a very cute game that anyone can enjoy, keep up the good work😊

Game freezes and you lose rolls when it does. I completed a star mission and it never activated (1.2k dice, cookies, and new sticker pack). Now I'm getting a 212 error, even though I have updated to the newest version and can't even get the game to load. It used to be a fun game, but the farther you get into it, the more it glitches and you lose items. Do not recommend.

I used to love this game. Today it has crashed about 20 times causing me to lose rolls, coins, & pet food even! I tried clearing space on my phone along with a few other trouble shooting methods & still it crashes. It mainly crashes when it's time for an animation like I get 3 ? Blocks or things like that. Fix it so I don't have to delete the game because overall it is a great game to relax to.

I used to love that game. Now, it rarely will get past the loading screen when I never had issues loading in the past. The pops ups are increasingly annoying, less rewards are being given, and you can no longer purchase stickers for a chance to complete an album. Whenever the game will load, the current side game will not nor will half the advertisements due to so many. Before the update, this was a great game. Now, I won't be playing much longer.

It starts off fun, as with any mobile game I do always expect a few ads or purchase suggestions as I'm playing, whatever, ya know. Don't have to. Well... eventually you have to. Eventually when you run out of rolls, any time you do ANYTHING you are greeted with anywhere from 2 to 4 ad windows in rapid succession telling you about heavily discounted packs which are always discounted anyway. Progress slows to a crawl and I'll admit I spent a little for fun. BUT THE PRICES GO HIGHER TOO Lol! Avoid

I used to enjoy this game a lot and played it often. I think it is very stupid how you only get 8-12 rolls(depending on level) within an hour of a waiting time. Another issue I have is ads. They are absurd, after you are done rolling you get about 10 pop up ads, and a lot of the time they all repeat themselves! I have also been having a lot of issues lately with attacking people then it glitches and will not give me the points promised 😞. Please fix this or I will delete the game.

Game is ok. 2 major problems though is that you get slammed with purchase options as soon as you open the game and it constantly freezes. When it freezes, you have to force close and lose your rolls with no rewards. When you re open game, you get slammed with purchase options again. Also when on the last roll, you get slammed with purchase options yet again. I just want to play the game without being subjected to make a a purchase 10 times a day and without it freezing.

For the last week or more, this app has failed to load successfully. It launches, but then stays on the splash screen indefinitely. I reached out to the publisher directly, hoping to hear back with word on how to resolve the issue, but I haven't heard anything. I enjoy this game a lot and have spent a not-insignificant amount of money on it. I would have hoped to hear back after my inquiry, but alas, I guess my user experience (and my business) isn't important to this publisher.

Updated to clarify: it isn't the ads that are ruining the experience. Every time I run out of dice, there are like 3 or more pop ups about the 3.99 and 99c. Every. Single. Time. Ads are fine. It's just the constantly having to close popups The amount of times the "deals" pop up is ruining my experience honestly. It lags my phone out. Otherwise I love this game.

Game lags and had lots of errors. sometimes it doesn't load completely and you play without being able to access the free rewards or option to purchase. Just today, I was playing the Trail Game and it didn't give me my rewards after landing at one of the chests. It gave an error message that said, "error with [giving] rewards. restart [game]." I restarted the game and no rewards and it wasn't the first time I've received that error message.

I've been playing for a year or so. Started out fun, now very disappointed in the game. It doesn't give me rolls or let me play the events and sometimes it takes rolls away when playing. The higher you go in the levels, the worse the game gets. Thinking seriously about uninstalling the game altogether. It costs too much to complete an inner level! Used to, I would complete 2 sometimes 3 levels a week, and now it takes almost 3 weeks to complete a level. Not much fun anymore.

I love it!!! To me it is perfect. Relaxing, entertaining, generous, and really funny. I play several times a day. And yes, I have spent money, because I wanted to not because I had to!! The only tiny thing I would like to see is different expressions on the attack peons face when he gets the shield. 😆 And maybe being able to scroll around to see the completed Kingdoms before moving on to the next. Pop ups have gotten ridiculous though. Lost a star.

I love this game, but I would like someone to contact me regarding some issues I'm having where the game just shuts itself down, and now I've lost our in free spins, and attacks, etc. It is starting to make me feel like not playing, a.d I play this game ALL THE TIME! Please contact me through email to discuss and fix, so that I may change my review, hopefully for the better! Ever since I updated to latest version, it won't load. Could use some help on that! My kingdom is getting attacked!

If you played games like coin master it's very similar. Uses cutier animations. You are forced (randomly) to attack or steal people's coins, and the same can happen to you but it seems it doesn't stop you too much from making progress. I've played other games where one loot prohibits your progress for the day. It's fun at least, and will take a bit more time then your usual toilet run, but it's interesting. Also, no Ads unless you click for it!

This game is super fun, and I play it pretty much daily. The graphics are decent, the game is relaxing and engaging, and there are rotating mini games and contests which make it more fun. My only complaint is that the pop-ups are OUT OF CONTROL. Upon opening the game, I have to spend a full minute or sometimes more just closing all the pop-ups before I can play. They come up frequently during gameplay as well which is very frustrating.

At first I loved this game but will probably delete. Every time you load the game, or beat a level it goes through all the game "offers" which are 6 icons on the right then it goes through all the pointless mini mini games that are icons on the left of the screen (5 at the moment). So now I barely get to roll and have to dismiss all those in game ads, and mini windows, and barely even get to play the game. I had it loaded for 18 minutes. I rolled like 6 times.

I love this game, but all the time the glitches. They use to respond fast. Now last two times I made purchases and didn't get everything. I understand it takes times but not 5 days. Then you don't get the rewards you were supposed to because the 4 day trail was already over. I was so close in fact I finished the trail and was battling the guy. If they b had fixed it faster I may have won. It hasn't gotten better. Rewards are lowered all of a sudden. And it's an exspensive game. If u make purchas

Having an absolute blast. Only thing that gets so frustrating it makes me want to delete is the over abundance of pop ups for the in app offers. They're plastered all over the screen, we know where to find them. It's even worse when you use all your energy rolls and watch the ad for more and once you use that spin it does the same thing. It's the one thing I would change, everything else is awesome! 2 👍👍up, highly recommend!!

I enjoy playing the game. However I feel like once I connected with Facebook instead of playing as a guest, my experience changed significantly. I would also like to mention the trails, during the mega move we should get everything we pass, it's very difficult to get coins or rolls from the trail. I also noticed I am now limited with revenge attacks, the algorithm has me attacking and stealing from my FB friends, but it's usually the same ones, it's getting annoying. Keep level progress for pets

I enjoy this game and its graphics. The only thing that I would change is the in store purchase options popping up so much. When you first start the game is understandable, but after you run out of rolls it gets a bit too much. There are times that I roll and it either freezes and I have to close and restart or it doesn't apply what was rolled. Other than those few things it's a fun game!

FUN! But with annoying pop ups. Whenever I run out of rolls I have to exit out of at least 5 or 6 pop ups to buy more rolls or whatever. I find that a little bit annoying and somwewhat of a turn off for me. I do still like playing the game but, I hope the devs will find a way to have a sort of "notification hub" for every offer, top up, sale item(s), etc all in one place.

Update: After seeing they fixed the problem I have stated, I've increased to 5 stars. They now have an option to select easy, medium or hard trail so if you're a casual player you can still complete the trail! Great work SuperPlay! No tricks anymore! It's a great addicting game. However they often trick you into spending money. There are trails that often happen in the game, each tier will tell you how many steps you need to get the next reward..that is until you get the 9th reward.

I really enjoy this game, but I have experienced some major technical flaws. Some days my daily rewards don't download and then I will just not get the prize that day. Right now, they have a 'three top three spots' prize happening and I've had a second and third place since the contest started, and it only shows one of them. These are minor issues (and there's more), but they give you more dice rolls which gives you more play time, so it's a bummer when you get shorted what you're deserved.

Pop up on this game are fn ridiculous. Bro let me fn play the game. We all see where and no how to buy stuff... don't need reminded every 2 seconds. 5 stars if not for pop ups!!! Not extremely fun. Something to do that you can really start getting into. The 4 million ads you get all day are annoying. If I want to buy, I'd buy. Don't force the pop-ups! Trading groups on Facebook could be a lot easier to trade if they set it up to easily trade cards but it's not.

I agree with some of the other reviewers. It's fun in the beginning but the more you level up the more discouraging it is to play. Upgrading buildings gets too expensive. You get stuck constantly repairing them. It's really frustrating when completed buildings get damaged and you have to pay again to complete them. Leveling up in games is supposed to be challenging but when it too hard it's no longer fun. Also the constant pop-ups to buy upgrades is REALLY annoying! I only need to see them once.

It is, indeed a charming little game. However, the constant bombardment of ads destroys it. Especially, after one runs low on dice rollls. The animation is interesting.... For the first five minutes and then it just gets old. Attacking other kingdoms is rudimentary, at best. The Revenge option is ok but there's no real way to bypass shields. One ends up looking like an idiot for attacking their attacker. Everything else is lame or rarely happens.

The game is a lot of fun and the little orange guys are so cute! I've been playing for a good minute now and the only thing that bothers me is how pushy the creators are about us spending money. We only need to see the offers once. The pictures on the right hand side of the screen make sure we don't forget them. Selling is necessary I get that, but aggressive selling really isn't with pictures that stay on screen while playing game. Otherwise, amazing game. Love it!

I love this game, I give it only four stars though because of the relentless prompts to buy things. Every time I'm out of money, or out of rolls, it goes through ALL the prompts to buy more rolls, or ALL the prompts to buy more credits, then it prompts ALL the deals the game is offering at the moment. You can easily click out of things, but you go through the process every time, if you are really playing the game, this can happen quite often and is very annoying.

Good time killer. Good daily rewards. Keeps me coming back every day. I've played this game almost daily over the last probably 2 years. Sometimes there's rigged competitions where there's no way this person has that many points so early into the competition, but I do find myself getting podium finishes in the game often enough. Edit 01/25/24: Don't buy any of the expensive items in the game because now I only have options to buy expensive items and I dont ever get podium finish. Losing a star ⭐

Ok so this game is legit fun and super easy. The characters are cute. The design is really well done. Playing rock paper scissors or attacking a friend or even stealing their gold😈😉 It's really a lot of fun. I have one issue, and though I get it, it's just really reeaalllyyy annoying.. and that's the amount of spend money pop ups you have to exit out of between everything you're doing in the game. Do that at the beginning when I open the app, not every single time I draw a card or lose dice!

I absolutely love this game BUT... The times I would roll 25 or 50, my prize screen would freeze and I would have to restart the game. The higher level I reach, the less free rolls I could get by watching ads. I had started buying roll packages that cost little money. After I've done that for a while now the only offers that come up are for higher dollar amounts. Everyone can't afford that and I refuse to pay it just because I had started to buy things Love it, but deleting it.

I waited a while before posting a review to give it a fair run. The graphics are great, the game is easy to play, so much so my littles can play. However, the pop ups from the game itself are the most annoying ever! Im not talking a couple, I mean 5-6 at one time trying to get you go buy more game items. Also, the ame will randomly stop playing and then freeze my whole phone up.

I'm playing this for Swagbucks money. It's interesting. The visuals are really good. There's a lot of different mini games going on (almost too much to keep track of). It's more interesting than Board Kings, but TOO MANY POP UPS come when you're close to being out of rolls & AGAIN when you actually run out. All these pop ups also come before the game starts. Honestly, PLEASE JUST HAVE THEM IN THE BEGINNING. It's way too agonizing & annoying to pop up for the rolls running low. Thanks.

I absolutely loved this game when I started playing it. But I apparently recently unlocked "albums". I can't do ANYTHING until I look at the video and the video NEVER works. It just sits at the "start button". And when I push the start button the error comes up saying "Something went wrong we are trying to fix it. You can try again via the ALBUM TRAILER button on the Album's menu" I literally, physically can't play this game anymore. Which is actually really sad because I really enjoyed it.

Change from my last, it's still a fun game but it's almost impossible to finish the tasks/trails, I've contacted them about adding friends for the extra gifts and they say they don't show anyone was added, the animals and card books are very difficult to finish unless you buy things. When I leave the game and go back, I almost always lose progress and my coins end up back in the "bank" and are then stolen. I'm just not sure if it's worth it the farther you go.

It is a fun game. My only problem with it is the pop ups that appear when you run out of dice. They are unrelenting. If you are using a multiplier and run lower than the number of the multiplier... you get bombarded with pop ups. Fine... But then if you change the multiplier amount and finish off your dice, those same pop ups bombard you for a second time. There needs to be a time out that says if I just watched these pop ups 30 seconds ago, don't bombard me again. I got the memos.

had a technical issue & support cleared it up almost immediately! very thankful for that. i would give 5 stars but when you first open the app. It changes your dice to the max amount that can be rolled. it also shoves deals for the game in your face without clicking on them. which doesn't allow me to play as much as I want.

Horrible, Horrible, Horrible!!! This used to be one of my favorite games but you have turned it into nothing but a cash grab. You now have to pay for almost everything. The algorithm is set to make sure you only win just enough to get the players to spend money to complete quest, keep your creature, etc. Now you have to pay to play the trails. Too many times, when I've come close to finishing I only get small rolls where we either spend money or not get to complete it. NOT fun anymore!!

I've been playing consistently since downloading this app, amongst many other apps similar. I want to say it's my favorite as it offers ads for a more free to play experience, nice for both parties. The concept I personally am not a fan of, I get that apps need to advertise their sales as well. But each and every time you run out of dice rolls, the number of pop ups each time when you can run out of dice can get a bit much at times. Otherwise, love this game and how it's far more different/fun.

Love this game, super addictive and takes some time away. I love to play at bedtime. there have been a few purchasing issues, but the team compensates you for your time. Plus gives you what you originally purchased. It does take a week or more to get back to you which can be frustrating. Hopefully they are able to fix the bugs so this stops happening.

It's an ok game and the graphics are great! You basically just tap a button to roll dice to get chance rewards, earn chance money, attack or steal from other players, or "battle" other players (just rock, paper, scissors). There are too many competitions, or other side "quests" going on, it's very scattered. My biggest complaint is that every time you run out of rolls there are 5 or 6 pop-ups prompting you to buy things from the game. And you have to close out of each them to do anything else.

I logged in and started the 60 rolls I had been waiting for. . The screen wasn't moving. After about 10 rolls, including hitting the attack and filling my power booster at the top, it said "the game needs to update." Last time I tried to update it, it didn't credit me back those spins or prizes and probably won't this time. So I uninstalled. Plus, tired of clicking the red X 5 times every time I run out of spins..

It's an interesting time-consuming game but sometimes it glitches. Not only does it glitch, while playing the event, doesn't accumulate to the number of what you rolled after getting a roll on it. Also, I wonder why we can't get back to the old albums (almost completed each of them). I feel like they're trying to loot players into buying. Please fix these issues, make it more convenient and fun for players to play. Thanks. Edit: Bring back the old Albums so we can finish completing them.

The game is fun. Love the autoroll feature. It's great when suddenly rewarded with 150 rolls! Once you've used your throws, it does take quite awhile for dice to build up. But...this is actually a good thing because it forces you to take a break (although that can be frustrating when you're close to a goal). The only real issue is trading cards. I don't want to add people I don't know to my facebook page. Perhaps we could swap extra cards for rolls or throws...I'm hoping with fingers crossed!

Game is pretty fun and I dig the graphics. But only on the second or third level and it makes you watch a video, can't skip it, and it keeps showing "ERROR". Stand still . I'm going to have to just delete the game so that's frustrating and a complete waste time. Especially being I downloaded it through an app that pays me to get to a certain level /time , which is no longer possible so thanks for that. Feel free to send me the $80 in Bitcoin I just got screwed out of👍🤷🚀

This game has been one of my absolute favorites for quite a few months now! I log in every single day and its a pretty easy game to play, even without the in app puchases. But I do wish a few things would happen in future updates. 1: A payable option to get rid of all of the pop up event packs 2: A way to see the map of kingdoms completed. Im really proud of them and it would be cool to look back on them. 3: A way to trade stickers for other items or to another person randomly like duels.

I enjoy playing the game very much. And the customer support is excellent now. However, at the current level I am at, it is nearly impossible to boost higher and complete additional quests without spending money. If you spend money, the cost increases to amounts that are unaffordable to the average player. And it has been over a year since a video mania, or video quest have been offered to get rolls & boost higher without spending. If the video mania/quests were offered I would rate higher.

I like the game, and have been playing for 5 months. I also like the cute Peons builders and different skills. The game is interactive, additive, attractive and fun. But this game is still not cheap at all. it is not easy to win / complete certain maintain unless one somethinng to keep maintain. The app recently has a lot of glitches. The customer support team has been trying to resolve issues in short time. It has improved a bit but still waiting to be better. Adding friends are not easy.

Been playing this game for a while now. Like over 1,000 crowns. It's one of the best lazy games out there. It keeps you coming back with keeping your kingdom intact and has variety in the mini games. You can unlock plenty of stuff to give you free rolls and coins. The stickers packs are a nice little reward to go for when you're low on rolls. Only complaint is after a while it can be slow moving. The cards don't level as fast as the buildings cost. But overall a good mobile game.

The first several levels of Dice Dreams was cool, I like the art design. The animation is a bit slow and unskippable. If you like that kinda stuff then it's cute. After you start progressing in the game you start getting hit with way too many unprompted popups and ads. Some of the popups you have to click the X multiple times. It gets extremely frustrating and annoying. Also, as for the card collection thing I get more duplicates than I do full sets.

The game play itself is actually fun. The problem is the constant, and I do mean CONSTANT pop ups of the in game micro transactions. It gets incredibly annoying to have to sit through anywhere from 3 to 10 pop ups of micro transactions that many times. I understand advertising and the need to make money, but... Each micro transaction also has a clickable icon on either side of the screen. At any point the player wishes, they can click the icon. The pop ups are too much!

WAY TOO MANY POP UPS! Fun but could be way better. The game is fun but getting pop ups constantly is annoying and takes away from the experience. The game is also very buggy, especially during the current event; my game froze at least 4 times the last time that I played it. During one of them, I was in the middle of stealing a friend's treasure and I had to exit the game to fix it. When I restarted, my game didn't pick up where I left off so I essentially lost out on the treasure and my rolls.

The pop up ads in this game are absolutely ridiculous. Every other game I play, the ads to buy stuff come up when you open the game, and maybe one pop-up when you run out of energy. This game bombards you with 7-10 pop-ups every time you go from side games back to the main board, etc. And when you run out of dice. Every. Single. Damn. Time! I'm giving it 2 stars because when you actually get to play, it's pretty fun. But the dice reload slow and little opportunity to get more without $$.

I did enjoy this game at one time. I'm thinking about uninstalling due to the fact that it freezes multiple times while playing. It's been doing this for probably about a month now. Once you close out and log back in after freezing, you have to go through the pop up ads all over. That gets old and redundant after the fifth time in an hour. You also lose your place and sometimes rewards that were earned it's more frustrating than fun anymore.

A few times purchases were made and I did NOT get what I purchased. Still waiting for responses from support for 2 of those purchases. The pop ups after you run low, or out of, dice are BEYOND annoying and unnecessary. It randomly freezes and you can't press anything, the only way to get it to work again is to close it and open it again. Several times, I've rolled things and it froze and I didn't get whatever it was I rolled. It is a fun game, there just needs to be MAJOR updates. Don't waste $$

It was fun! Already on my 40th kingdom. After my 30th, it started messing up. It freezes, skipped my turn for the trial part of the game, I won 8th place in a tournament where I was supposed to get 40 dice rolls and I don't know how many coins but it never gave them to me! Now I'm already thinking of just deleting it before it gets worse & just ends up being more of a wasted time. & yes it's updated!

Easy to play and pretty much stress free. I really love this game. Plenty of rewards and fun characters. I haven't experienced any frustrating episodes. Months later, and I continue to enjoy Dice Dreams and play daily! I have to say, though, the purchase requests can be annoying but at the same time they offer plenty of options for everyone's budget.

Stop repeatedly popping up the same windows! The game is cute and fun - a good way to kill a little time. There are plenty of offers to purchase but you don't have to. The problem I have is they pop up an offer. Then the same offer. And then the same offer. Over and over. In between levels. In between switching to build mode. In between switching to a mini game. ALL. THE. TIME. I spend as much time closing out pop ups as I do rolling dice.

This is a one of a kind game. You are on a quest to restore all the kingdoms that have been lost/destroyed. There's many different things to do and compete in. It is a time idle game where you can only do so much at a time without paying, but there is always lots of ways to get rewards and such without ever paying a cent. No ads unless you choose to, and they do come with rewards. This game is very fun. Only problem I've had was not receiving reward for friends joing. Otherwise, perfect game.

Fun however.....the farther you get in the game the harder it is to do the most basic things. I can't really complete the events or sometimes participate, as it takes too much money to build and upgrade. This game is really fun in my opinion , I just don't get to really enjoy it anymore. That's sad because if there were more options to play, I'd play more (ex: selling extra cards for more dice). I don't mind the endless free ad dice options, but that's not an everyday option.

2nd Update: Sooo, I still like the game alot. The only thing I find annoying right now is that the lags seem "planned". Not cool when I'm trying to beat the clock. Then I exit and open the game again and miraculously its functioning again. Update: the lags have been fixed and I still like the game!! It's pretty fun. It lags sometimes, but maybe that's what all these back to back updates are for. I'll keep playing .

I absolutely love this game! It's challenging yet, doesn't overload you with various tasks to get the next level. The graphics are exceptional. The characters are perfectly adorable. Zero glitches. It doesn't inundate you with too many ads, you can watch ads for freebies to keep playing. I must admit that I'm a little hurt when someone steals my coins or damages my village but all's fair while in a war right? Lol It's a great game to pass the time but be careful because it is addicting!

I just deleted the game. My game was running super slow. And every time I rolled anything good. It would completely freeze and kick me out. I tried to send in a complaint and couldn't even get the support option to even let me message them. Too much trouble and losing too many things that I should have rightfully had gotten. I enjoyed the game but it is stressing me out. I go to watch a video and halfway the the ad and it kicks me out. So even the video mania is useless to me.

Very enjoyable and addictive game to play. Graphics are AWESOME! Moves along quickly and rewards are seemingly plentiful, allowing one to advance in the game without requiring purchase (while you can purchase). It appears as though should one decide to purchase, the costs is low. I have to watch every nickle and dime, so game purchases are NOT an option for me. Otherwise, I'm enjoying the game thus far.

I started playing this game 10 months ago for a gaming rewards app and it has yet to get old. It's effectively a hybrid of Coin Master and Board Kings, but it blows both of those out of the water. Minigames on certain rolls stop the gameplay from becoming monotonous and I like the design better, too. When the game wouldn't open, I contacted their support team and they fixed it very quickly. I didn't lose any of my progress. A good game with good support is rare, so I highly recommend it!

Overall it's a fun game and decent time killer. Only complaints are occasional freezing that forces me to close the game and the aggressive monetization. You'll be assaulted by ads constantly. Out of everyone I know playing, only my fiancee is unable to watch ads for more rolls for some reason. The option isn't even there. She hasn't been able to watch an ad for weeks now and can't get any help from the devs, which she contacted like 3 times. I don't think they understand what the problem is.

Cute game, fun to play at times. Very predictable. The money awarded doesn't add up to the cost of upgrades as you level up. Super forceful with microtransactions. Constantly shoving pop ups in your face pressuring you to spend money, really gets annoying at times. Ads are optional to watch, which is cool. But boy run out of dice and you have to click 3 to 5 pop up purchases that get extremely annoying every time you play.

Sorry Dice Dreams, changed my review. I still enjoy the game but was not happy with finally getting to the end of the trail only to find I can't finish without beating the big guy. I even bought rolls, twice, and it wasn't nearly enough. You are lucky to make it that far to begin with, so this was a real disappointment for me that it would have cost me more money for the 2000 roles plus rewards. Make it challenging, I get that, but make it possible without having to go broke!

I play this game several times a day and its really fun. I give it 4 stars instead of 5 because the ads are just so annoying and I hate the fighting mode because usually I just get some money but not very many and I never get dice as a prize and when I do it's like 3 or 5. The trails need to have less steps cuz I can't play 24/7. And sometimes when I'm rolling dice and it's on automatic and I get those charms to unlock things, it glitches and doesn't give me them and just moves to the next roll.

This is a really fun game :] fun for when you're bored of everything else. Although, i would rather have the timer for when you get more rolls, go down to 20 or 30 mins per 5 rolls you earn. Edit: It went down a star because of the dang pop-ups! When you run out of rolls, the pop-ups show up and it's annoying. If I want to spend money, I know where it is, no need to shove it in my face. If this gets fixed, it'll go back up.

Love this game can't stop playing it! There so much to build, explore, and more. The little characters are adorable and the treasure hunts! The chapter map is awesome so many cool places to stay and build. Stickers are awesome to see what memories you've had. But you can't go back to the places you've done. But there is a lot of stuff that you have to buy with real money and you get a lot of rolls. It's kid friendly and for adults too. But if you haven't got Dice Dreams get it now!!!!!!!!!

Nice simple game. Very addictive. Some of the In game purchase prices are excessively high compared to other games. Prices should be lowered for in game purchases...they are too high for some of the items compared to other games. This game is great, except a MAJOR bummer is the stupid pop up ads, like 10 in a row, and the close button doesn't work, just tries to charge and ask for money way too much, however the game is awesome, but I have tremors in both hands and this is becoming very irritating more than fun, if you can stop the pop ups, I'll give a better review and change my rating!! I like the game it's fun to jump into maybe twice a day for maybe only a few minutes. My only problem is with all the in-app purchase pop ups. The game buffers a lot and sometimes starts over. However it's one of my favorites to play on a daily. Also you have to go through a lot of offers before being able to play the game. I'm addicted to it!

It's fun, addicting & simple to play. Only grievance is how EVERY SINGLE in game ad pops up EVERY TIME you're low on any of the game "currency" used to play. Haha

Used to love it (despite the 80 pop-ups). But then it suddenly got laggy and stopped giving me the things I won. I won 1600 dice, the game froze and I didn't get it. This game is awesome, I happened to see an ad for it and was pulled in... I love the bright colors and sounds, each board is super colorful, it's very challenging, and the challenges are so fun, great daily deals if you like to make purchases. I wish I had more time to play, but I try to play at least daily, got to grab those daily bonuses, and get my builds on... it's really hard to break away from playing... yes, I'm addicted, haha... Fun game minus occasional glitches. There's always a lot going on. This game is addictive but has so many bugs. It makes me really mad! 1. Many times I win tournaments but reward doesn't pay out. 2. The games and offers take forever to load when entering the game, then you start playing, attack/fight/steal and then only afterwards they load, meaning you missed out on trail tokens or event points. Only to mention a few!

Too many pop ups, it really stunts game play when you run out of rolls and have to go through 5 ads EVERY time. Apparently the new puzzle game is making the game lock up so it can't be played. I've tried restarting the game 3 times when this happens and it doesn't help. The pop-ups are ridiculously constant and there's too much flashy time wasting stuff. There are way better games than this one. I am editing my last review because some changes have been made to the game, and it has become a slightly easier to achieve getting certain goals. all right I really like this game so I did not complain but now I'm complaining six times in a row I haven't gotten 600 rolls that I was supposed to get for free by watching a video. four times I have not gotten the things that I have purchased. I am not happy with you.

Dice Dreams is a fun, casual game that offers a light-hearted mix of luck and strategy. The gameplay is simple: roll dice to earn coins, attack other players' kingdoms, and build your own. Its colorful graphics and engaging animations make it visually appealing, and the social aspect, where you can attack friends or random players, adds to the fun. However, it can feel repetitive over time, with limited strategic depth beyond just rolling and hoping for the best outcome.
